jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Platform Reliability and Application Support
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Become part of our team as a Senior Specialist in Platform Reliability and Application Support, focusing on enhancing the reliability of Inception42’s platforms and applications. You will investigate production issues, build operational tooling, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal for experienced engineers with strong application support expertise.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview

Improve the production reliability of the platforms, products and applications developed by Inception42 for internal users and external customers. You will combine application support experience with engineering to detect problems early, restore service effectively and prevent recurrence.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on application and service reliability. You will investigate across code and runtime dependencies, build useful operational tooling and work closely with Product Engineering to make services easier to operate and recover.

Works within Tech Services alongside platform leadership, Product Engineering, Application Support, Azure Cloud, NetSecOps and Information Security. Partners with Application Support on customer cases and communicates directly with internal users and external customers during technical investigations and incidents.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

• Understand assigned services end to end, including user journeys, application components, data flows, runtime behaviour and third-party dependencies.

• Implement service level indicators and agreed reliability objectives with service owners, covering user-relevant availability, latency and successful processing.

• Build and improve logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerting so operational teams can identify customer impact and locate failures quickly.

• Diagnose production issues across application code, APIs, queues, databases, containers and underlying services, working with domain engineers where needed.

• Read source code and trace execution paths to explain failures; write tested automation, diagnostic tooling and reviewed reliability improvements.

• Respond to incidents, coordinate technical recovery for assigned services and provide clear updates on impact, evidence, mitigation and recovery confidence.

• Work directly with customers and internal users during complex investigations, explaining findings in accessible language and keeping communication aligned with Application Support.

• Improve deployment readiness, health checks and recovery mechanisms with Engineering. Validate changes through staged rollout, operational checks and agreed rollback criteria.

• Identify capacity limits and failure modes; conduct performance and resilience testing, including dependency failure and service recovery exercises.

• Use incident reviews, reliability trends and error-budget consumption to propose improvement priorities and eliminate repetitive manual operational work.

• Maintain runbooks, secure operational access and clean handovers; share knowledge and drive corrective actions through to verified outcomes.

• Within the first six months: Assigned services have documented dependencies, useful health indicators and actionable runbooks; Priority observability and recovery gaps are addressed, with clear incident and customer communication; Initial engineering improvements reduce a measurable source of failure or manual operational effort.

• Within the first twelve months: Agreed reliability measures and recovery performance improve against established baselines; Recurring incidents and unnecessary alerts reduce through verified corrective actions; Reliability findings influence release readiness and engineering priorities, with operational knowledge shared across teams.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• Strong production application support or reliability engineering experience with software products, including complex incidents and customer-facing technical communication.

• Ability to read and debug application code in a relevant language, such as Python, Java, C#, Go or JavaScript/TypeScript, and connect code behaviour with runtime evidence.

• Ability to write maintainable automation or tooling, use Git, review changes and apply appropriate tests before production use.

• Practical experience with observability, distributed tracing, alerting and service health measures; able to distinguish symptoms from contributing causes.

• Working knowledge of Linux, containers, cloud services, APIs, databases and networking sufficient to troubleshoot across a distributed application.

• Experience with CI/CD, production change validation, incident response and recovery, with clear attention to access controls and customer data.

• Strong communication and independent problem-solving skills, with evidence of reducing recurring failures or operational effort through engineering.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Kubernetes or OpenShift, Azure, infrastructure as code and open observability tooling.

• Experience implementing service level objectives, error-budget practices, load testing or resilience exercises.

• Exposure to AI inference or data-processing platforms, including dependencies, queue behaviour and specialised capacity constraints.

Participates in an agreed production on-call rota, incident response, maintenance and recovery exercises according to service commitments.

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jobs.title: System Engineer
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Take on the role of System Engineer to maintain, secure, and optimise hybrid IT environments supporting AIQ’s platforms and services. You will manage IT support, identity and access management, and infrastructure, ideal for candidates with strong technical expertise in cloud and systems administration.
jobs.description:
About the Company:

AIQ is an Abu Dhabi-based technology company that develops and deploys industrial artificial intelligence (AI) technologies at scale, focused on the energy sector. As a venture between Presight (G42) and ADNOC, AIQ has productized 15 AI-enabled solutions that support clients to perform better, protect teams and equipment, keep operations sustainable, and rapidly scale successes. The organization embraces an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, looking to push boundaries and solve transformational challenges across industry. It welcomes professionals that share the desire to make meaningful and impactful contributions to the mission to deliver responsible AI to the heart of industrial processes. Always on the forefront of technology, AIQ provides its talent with an environment to thrive and excel. Working at AIQ includes participating in some of the most significant industrial transformation projects, interacting with massive data pools, utilizing sophisticated AI infrastructure that is powered by a NVIDIA GPU cloud computing platform, and access to abundant computing, storage, and network resources made available from across the G42 ecosystem.

Overview:


Job Title: System Engineer

Location: Abu Dhabi, UAE

About the Company:

AIQ is an Abu Dhabi-based technology company that develops and deploys industrial artificial intelligence (AI) technologies at scale, focused on the energy sector. As a venture between Presight (G42) and ADNOC, AIQ has productized 15 AI-enabled solutions that support clients to perform better, protect teams and equipment, keep operations sustainable, and rapidly scale successes. The organization embraces an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, looking to push boundaries and solve transformational challenges across industry. It welcomes professionals that share the desire to make meaningful and impactful contributions to the mission to deliver responsible AI to the heart of industrial processes. Always on the forefront of technology, AIQ provides its talent with an environment to thrive and excel. Working at AIQ includes participating in some of the most significant industrial transformation projects, interacting with massive data pools, utilizing sophisticated AI infrastructure that is powered by a NVIDIA GPU cloud computing platform, and access to abundant computing, storage, and network resources made available from across the G42 ecosystem.

About the role:

The System Engineer is a key role responsible for maintaining, securing, and optimizing the hybrid IT environments that underpin AIQ’s AI platforms and services.

Responsibilities:


Key Responsibilities

1. End-User & Workforce Support

• Provide day-to-day IT assistance for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals.
• Troubleshoot software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Deliver IT inductions and onboarding sessions for new staff, ensuring awareness of IT policies, tools, and security practices.
• Support staff during offboarding by handling account closures, data backup, and access removal.

2. Identity & Access Management

• Manage onboarding/offboarding, role transitions, and permissions
• Manage Azure, Active Directory, M365, SailPoint, DFS, DHCP, DNS and internal systems.
• Implement Conditional Access and MFA policies.
• Resolve account lockouts and access escalations.

3. Collaboration & Productivity Tools

• Administer Microsoft Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
• Enable secure collaboration with external stakeholders.
• Support staff in managing shared drives, permissions, and access rights.

4. Infrastructure & Systems Management

• Oversee networks, VPN connectivity, servers, and cloud resources.
• Ensure high availability and resilience of IT services.
• Manage system upgrades, patching, and performance monitoring.
• Manage security configurations and troubleshooting.

5. Security & Compliance

• Enforce corporate security standards, including MDM enrollment, encryption, and patch compliance.
• Monitor and respond to security alerts.
• Support InfoSec audits and governance requirements.

6. Project & Technical Enablement

• Provide technical support to project teams, including specialized setups (Linux environments, GPU/AI workstations, DGX systems, Docker, GitHub/GitLab).
• Assist teams in configuring and maintaining project-required equipment.
• Support deployment of new technologies for AI and data-driven projects.

7. Procurement & Asset Management

• Manage IT stock, hardware allocation, and lifecycle tracking.
• Oversee procurement requests, license renewals, and warranty claims.
• Liaise with vendors for service, repairs, and escalations.

8. Incident & Escalation Management

• Act as the single point of contact for IT escalations.
• Coordinate with global support teams and vendors for complex issues.
• Ensure business continuity by minimizing downtime and resolving critical incidents quickly.

9. Process & Service Delivery

• Manage IT service requests through ticketing systems.
• Streamline IT processes for efficiency and compliance.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives in IT operations and service delivery.

Qualifications:


Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field, or relevant work experience.
• Certifications including Network Administrator, Microsoft MCSA, Microsoft Azure

Preferred Experience

• 5+ years as Systems and Business Support and Cloud administrator.
• Strong experience in IT Asset management , hardware build including Windows and MacOs.
• Strong experience in Active Directory, Exchange, Office 365, Windows Server, Azure, and AWS.
• Previous experience in a help desk support or troubleshooting role, particularly in a 24/7 managed services environment.
• Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Cloud Services, including Azure and Active Directory

• Strong understanding of internet protocols, LAN/WAN networking, firewalls and protocols such as DNS, HTTP, LDAP, SMTP, and SNMP.

Soft Skills

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills
• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
• Proactive mindset with attention to infrastructure performance and security
• Effective communicator with cross-functional collaboration experience

What working at AIQ offers:

Culture: Encouraging initiative, work in an environment that is fast-paced and varied, surrounded by talented peers from around the world, who are similarly attracted to applying their skills to solve transformational challenges.

Career: Join a team in which your contribution is recognized and rewarded, while you are supported to operate at your peak performance.

Rewards: An attractive renumeration package that includes healthcare, education support for dependents, leave benefits, and more.

jobs.title: Senior SOC Engineer- SIEM (UAEN)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Join us as a Senior SOC Engineer, managing SIEM services within the Security Operations Centre, with a focus on Splunk SIEM and UEBA. Oversee onboarding new log sources, optimise telemetry, and support architecture improvements. Ideal for candidates with significant SOC experience and expertise in Splunk SIEM management.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Senior SOC Engineer is responsible for managing SIEM services within the Security Operations Center, with a primary focus on Splunk SIEM and Splunk UEBA. This role involves onboarding new log sources, optimizing telemetry, ensuring system updates, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining SIEM performance. Additionally, the engineer will support SIEM architecture improvements and deployments aligned with business requirements.

Responsibilities:


Key Responsibilities:

• Manage Splunk SIEM services within the SOC environment.
• Implement scalable Splunk-based SIEM solutions following best practices.
• Define data ingestion strategies, parsing logic, and correlation rules.
• Onboard new log sources and ensure proper integration with Splunk SIEM.
• Monitor and maintain critical log sources; troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly.
• Optimize telemetry for improved data collection, correlation, and reporting.
• Collaborate with SOC and threat intelligence teams to develop detection use cases.
• Create dashboards, alerts, and reports for proactive threat monitoring.
• Perform system updates, version upgrades, and feature rollouts.
• Ensure CIM compliance, field extractions, and data normalization.
• Maintain SIEM performance and troubleshoot Splunk-related issues.
• Evaluate and deploy Splunk apps and add-ons as needed.
• Document SIEM workflows, configurations, and operational procedures.
• Support continuous process improvements to enhance SOC efficiency. Work cross-functionally with IT, DevOps, and security teams.

Characteristics:

• Profound knowledge and hands-on experience with Splunk SIEM, UEBA and other related technologies like CRIBL.
• Understanding of SOC workflows, MITRE ATT&CK framework, and threat detection methodologies.
• Ability to correlate data across multiple sources to identify patterns and anomalies.
• Strong understanding of cloud and network technologies, essential for efficient log source onboarding.
• Proven technical capabilities in a complex, fast-paced SOC environment.
• Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot log source issues related to cloud and network infrastructures.
• Strong understanding of SOC operations, cybersecurity principles, and best practices.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions under pressure.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with a variety of team members, including interfacing with customers to resolve issues.
• High proficiency in written and verbal communication

Qualifications:


Skills/Certifications (Technical & Non-Technical)

• Splunk Certified Administrator.
• Mastery of SPL (Search Processing Language) for complex queries, dashboards, and reports.
• Scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
• Cloud-related certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC is preferred.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills
• Ability to lead technical initiatives and work independently

Minimum Work Experience

• A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in SOC operations, with significant experience in Splunk SIEM management.
• Prior experience in a technical role within a SOC or similar cybersecurity environment.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: We are currently hiring a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and deployment of advanced edge controllers for smart completion wells. You will drive software architecture, optimise control logic, and ensure secure, real-time execution. Ideal candidates bring extensive experience in autonomous control systems and strong expertise in C++ and Python on industrial edge hardware.
jobs.description:
About the Company:

AIQ is an Abu Dhabi-based technology company that develops and deploys industrial artificial intelligence (AI) technologies at scale, focused on the energy sector. As a venture between Presight (G42) and ADNOC, AIQ has productized 15 AI-enabled solutions that support clients to perform better, protect teams and equipment, keep operations sustainable, and rapidly scale successes. The organization embraces an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, looking to push boundaries and solve transformational challenges across industry. It welcomes professionals that share the desire to make meaningful and impactful contributions to the mission to deliver responsible AI to the heart of industrial processes. Always on the forefront of technology, AIQ provides its talent with an environment to thrive and excel. Working at AIQ includes participating in some of the most significant industrial transformation projects, interacting with massive data pools, utilizing sophisticated AI infrastructure that is powered by a NVIDIA GPU cloud computing platform, and access to abundant computing, storage, and network resources made available from across the G42 ecosystem.

Overview:


Purpose of the role

AIQ is building RoboWell APC, the autonomous execution layer of its production platform: a model-predictive control (MPC) engine that runs on edge hardware inside the operator’s OT environment and closes the loop on wells in real time. The first target is smart completions — wells equipped with downhole inflow control valves (ICVs), permanent downhole gauges and surface chokes — where the APC will continuously re-optimise zonal inflow and lift settings against reservoir, well-integrity and facility constraints, with the control room supervising rather than driving.

We are looking for a hands-on technical lead who can take this from control-algorithm design and simulator validation all the way to a hardened, containerised, cyber-compliant deployment on field edge devices, integrated with the DCS/SCADA and with AIQ’s IT layer (NextGenCCR, AiPSO, the IT/OT bridge). You will own the software architecture of the edge controller and be the engineer who makes it run safely on real wells.

Responsibilities:


•

Key responsibilities

Control & optimisation

• Design and implement MPC / constrained-optimisation controllers for multi-zone smart-completion wells (ICV position, choke, gas-lift or ESP set-points), including the process models, constraint handling, disturbance estimation and objective functions they rely on.
• Build the supervisory logic around the controller: operating envelopes, well-integrity and equipment limits, mode management (auto / advisory / manual), bumpless transfer, fallback and safe-state behaviour.
• Work with production and reservoir engineers to translate operating philosophy and constraints into controller behaviour, and to define the KPIs the APC is judged on.

Edge software & deployment

• Own the edge software architecture: soft-real-time execution in C++ / Python on industrial edge hardware (Linux), containerised (Docker / OCI), with deterministic scheduling, watchdogs, state persistence and remote update.
• Implement the southbound integration to the control system — OPC UA, Modbus/TCP, DNP3 or vendor protocols — with read-back verification, write-permission handling and full change traceability.
• Implement the northbound integration to the AIQ IT layer through the IT/OT bridge (policy-enforced fetcher, DMZ / containment zone): model and configuration distribution, telemetry and observability from every hop back to the control centre.
• Meet operator OT cybersecurity requirements (IEC 62443 zoning, hardening, signed artefacts, secrets handling, audit logging) and support site surveys, FAT/SAT and cyber approvals for deployment.

Verification & field delivery

• Build and maintain the SIL/HIL test environment: closed-loop testing of the APC against well and network simulators and against physical controllers before anything is written to a live well.
• Lead the field pilots on smart-completion wells with the operator’s control-room and production teams: commissioning, tuning, performance monitoring and hand-over to operations.
• Establish CI/CD-to-device pipelines, release management and documentation (SDDs, interface control documents, test reports) to the standard expected by the operator’s architecture and cyber teams.

Technical leadership

• Set the technical direction of the edge / APC workstream and mentor developers and data engineers working on it; review designs and code.
• Represent the edge architecture in front of operator architects, OT / cybersecurity teams and AIQ leadership; contribute to proposals and roadmaps for RoboWell APC across ESP, gas-lift and natural-flow wells.

Qualifications:


•

Required qualifications and experience

• MSc (or equivalent) in Control Engineering, Robotics, Electronic / Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
• 8+ years building software for autonomous or mission-critical control systems, with a track record of taking a system from concept through simulation and HIL to real-hardware deployment and field validation.
• Strong practical MPC / optimal-control background: formulating and solving constrained MPC problems, state estimation (Kalman / MHE), model identification and controller tuning on real plant.
• Expert C++ (C++17 or later) and Python on Linux, including multithreading, soft-real-time design, memory and latency optimisation, and profiling on constrained edge hardware.
• Hands-on with industrial / field communication protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT) and with interfacing software to PLC / DCS / SCADA or flight-controller-class hardware.
• Experience with containerised on-device deployment, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows and observability (structured logging, metrics, telemetry).
• Experience designing and using SIL / HIL test environments and simulators for closed-loop verification.
• Fluent English; able to write clear architecture and interface documents and present to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

• Exposure to oil & gas production operations — smart completions / ICVs, artificial lift (ESP, gas lift), well and network simulators (e.g. PIPESIM, OLGA, Prosper/GAP) — or willingness to learn the domain quickly.
• Familiarity with OT cybersecurity practice: IEC 62443, DMZ / data-diode architectures, device hardening, signed and verified software distribution.
• Applied reinforcement learning or learning-based control, and experience combining ML models with classical controllers in a safe, supervised manner.
• Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or similar accelerated edge platforms, and with ROS 2 / DDS middleware.
• Prior experience in a lead or architect role delivering software into a regulated or safety-critical environment (aerospace, defence, energy, utilities).

What success looks like in the first 12 months

• An APC edge stack that passes closed-loop SIL/HIL validation against the smart-completion well simulator and the operator’s cyber and architecture review.
• RoboWell APC running in closed loop on a first set of smart-completion wells, with measured production uplift or constraint-compliance improvement and a documented hand-over to the control room.
• A reusable, documented edge platform (deployment, protocol adapters, observability, update path) that the wider RoboWell team can extend to ESP and gas-lift wells.

What working at AIQ offers:

Culture: Encouraging initiative, work in an environment that is fast-paced and varied, surrounded by talented peers from around the world, who are similarly attracted to applying their skills to solve transformational challenges.

Career: Join a team in which your contribution is recognized and rewarded, while you are supported to operate at your peak performance.

Rewards: An attractive renumeration package that includes healthcare, education support for dependents, leave benefits, and more.

Location: Abu Dhabi | Reports to: Christophe Van Laer

About the Company:

AIQ is an Abu Dhabi-based technology company that develops and deploys industrial artificial intelligence (AI) technologies at scale, focused on the energy sector. As a venture between Presight (G42) and ADNOC, AIQ has productized 15 AI-enabled solutions that support clients to perform better, protect teams and equipment, keep operations sustainable, and rapidly scale successes. The organization embraces an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, looking to push boundaries and solve transformational challenges across industry. It welcomes professionals that share the desire to make meaningful and impactful contributions to the mission to deliver responsible AI to the heart of industrial processes. Always on the forefront of technology, AIQ provides its talent with an environment to thrive and excel. Working at AIQ includes participating in some of the most significant industrial transformation projects, interacting with massive data pools, utilizing sophisticated AI infrastructure that is powered by a NVIDIA GPU cloud computing platform, and access to abundant computing, storage, and network resources made available from across the G42 ecosystem.

The role

AIQ is building software and AI products for well surveillance, artificial-lift optimisation and autonomous production. We are seeking a petroleum production engineer who has improved the performance of real wells and can translate that experience into reliable digital products. You will provide the engineering leadership for electric submersible pump (ESP), gas-lift and naturally flowing well workflows, working with software engineers, AI scientists and controls specialists to progress from diagnosis and recommendations to validated closed-loop operation.

Responsibilities:


What you will do

• Define surveillance and optimisation workflows for ESP wells, including pump selection and operating range, intake conditions, free gas, motor loading and temperature, vibration, variable-speed drive settings and failure diagnosis.
• Develop gas-lift and naturally flowing well workflows covering injection performance, valve behaviour, unloading and instability, choke response and network backpressure. Evaluate well settings within shared gas-supply and facility constraints.
• Build, calibrate and challenge well-performance models using nodal analysis, inflow and outflow relationships, fluid properties and equipment data. Partner with the PTA SME to separate reservoir or skin changes from lift, wellbore and measurement effects.
• Define engineering requirements for virtual flow metering, sensor validation, anomaly detection and equipment-health models. Specify reference measurements, uncertainty, alarm usefulness and the conditions that require engineering review.
• Translate operating practices into decision logic for start-up, shutdown, recovery and optimisation. Work with controls and operational-technology specialists on operating envelopes, permissives, setpoint and ramp limits, fallback behaviour and operator override.
• Lead engineering validation from historical replay and simulation through advisory pilots to supervised closed-loop trials. Define acceptance criteria for degraded sensors, communications loss and unfamiliar operating conditions, alongside normal performance.
• Support field trials, investigate failures and measure production, energy and reliability outcomes against credible baselines. Convert lessons into reusable requirements, benchmark cases and operator guidance, and support customer adoption and technical demonstrations.

Qualifications:


Essential experience

• Degree in Petroleum Engineering, or a related engineering degree with substantial petroleum production engineering experience. Typically 12 or more years of relevant experience, including recent hands-on work with producing wells.
• Deep ESP engineering expertise demonstrated through selection, diagnosis, optimisation and operational troubleshooting. Substantive gas-lift operating or optimisation experience is also required, with the ability to diagnose performance beyond a single equipment vendor.
• Strong well-performance and nodal-analysis capability, including fluid properties, multiphase flow, inflow and outflow relationships and the interaction between reservoir deliverability and artificial lift.
• Delivery of digital well surveillance, remote optimisation or automation workflows into routine field use. Experience defining operational requirements and validating solutions with software, analytics or controls teams.
• Practical understanding of Pressure Transient Analysis (PTA) results and their limitations. Ability to apply changes in reservoir pressure, productivity and skin to lift decisions, with specialist interpretations owned by the PTA SME.
• Hands-on use of PROSPER, PIPESIM, DesignRite or equivalent well and lift engineering tools. Ability to work with historian or SCADA data, well tests, equipment records and operating-event histories.
• Experience defining safe operating envelopes and participating in operational change reviews. Clear understanding of supervisory optimisation, regulatory control and independent safety protection, and when optimisation should stop.
• Evidence of field improvements supported by data, technical leadership and effective collaboration with operators. Professional English communication and the ability to write requirements that engineers and developers can implement.

Preferred experience

• Supervised closed-loop deployments, advanced process control, model predictive control, edge applications or integration between production software and control-room systems.
• Physics-based or hybrid AI models, virtual flow metering, equipment reliability analysis, automated diagnostic workflows, or Python/SQL for engineering analysis.
• Offshore and Middle East operations, intelligent completions or downhole gas-lift valves. Experience with other lift methods is useful as the product expands.

Your contribution to the product team

You own production and lift requirements and domain validation. Controls specialists own control-system design and integration, with customer approval for field changes. You partner with the integrated-production SME on field constraints and target feasibility. Supervisory optimisation must preserve independent protection and the operator’s ability to intervene.

What working at AIQ offers:

Culture: Encouraging initiative, work in an environment that is fast-paced and varied, surrounded by talented peers from around the world, who are similarly attracted to applying their skills to solve transformational challenges.

Career: Join a team in which your contribution is recognized and rewarded, while you are supported to operate at your peak performance.

Rewards: An attractive renumeration package that includes healthcare, education support for dependents, leave benefits, and more.

jobs.title: Director - Cyber Consulting Services (CPX)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Seeking a strategic leader to direct our GRC Services practice, overseeing governance, risk, and compliance advisory across regulated and unregulated sectors. Drive service delivery, client relationships, and commercial performance. Ideal for an experienced professional with a strong background in governance, risk, and compliance leadership.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Director – GRC Services leads the governance, risk and compliance advisory practice, holding overall accountability for service delivery, client relationships, commercial performance and people leadership across the practice. The role sets the strategic direction for GRC offerings, oversees the quality of engagements delivered to clients across regulated and unregulated sectors, and acts as the senior point of escalation on technical, commercial and risk matters. Reporting to the Executive Director – CCS, the Director translates the firm’s growth strategy into a high-performing, profitable and scalable GRC service line.

Responsibilities:


• Define and execute the strategy, service portfolio and go-to-market plan for the GRC Services line in alignment with the firm’s overall advisory strategy.
• Own the practice profit-and-loss, including revenue targets, utilization, margin, pricing and resource planning.
• Identify emerging regulatory, governance and risk themes (e.g. ESG, data protection, AI governance) and shape new propositions and methodologies in response. Represent the firm and the GRC practice in the market through thought leadership, industry forums, regulator engagement and speaking opportunities
• Build and maintain trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite, board and audit-committee stakeholders across client organizations.
• Lead origination and conversion of new business, including proposals, pitches, scoping and commercial negotiation.
• Drive cross-selling across other advisory and assurance service lines and manage a portfolio of strategic accounts.
• Hold ultimate delivery accountability for GRC engagements, including governance reviews, enterprise risk management, regulatory compliance, internal controls, policy frameworks and risk transformation programmes.
• Review and approve key deliverables, ensuring technical accuracy, methodological rigor and alignment with applicable standards and regulations (e.g. ISO 31000, COSO ERM, ISO 27001, Central Bank of the UAE, DFSA/DIFC, FSRA/ADGM, SCA requirements).
• Serve as the senior escalation point for complex technical issues, delivery risks and client concerns.
• Lead, mentor and develop managers and consultants, setting performance objectives and supporting career progression.
• Build the capability and capacity of the practice through recruitment, training, knowledge management and succession planning.

Skills :-

• NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27005, and CIS Controls.

• UAE Information Assurance (UAE IA) Standards and applicable UAE Cybersecurity Council guidance.

• TDRA cybersecurity guidelines and other relevant UAE sectoral regulations.

• Cyber maturity models and quantitative cyber risk methodologies (e.g., FAIR).

• Excellent executive stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation and business-development skills.

• Strong technical command across governance, enterprise risk and regulatory compliance.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including board-level reporting and presentation.

Qualifications:


Tools Experience : -

• GRC platforms (e.g. ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer or equivalent).

• Enterprise reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) for executive and board reporting.

• Risk and compliance management, audit and workpaper tooling.

• Standard productivity and collaboration suites (Microsoft 365 or equivalent).

Education & Minimum Work Experience : -

• Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in governance, risk and/or compliance, including significant experience in a professional service / consulting environment.

• Minimum 5 years in a leadership role with delivery, P&L and business-development accountability.

• Demonstrated track record of leading and growing a practice or large engagements across regulated sectors.

• Experience advising on or delivering national / sector-wide cyber governance and assurance programmes — such as the National Cybersecurity Index Program — is strongly preferred..Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.

• Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.title: Manager - Cyber Consulting Services (CPX)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: We are looking for a Manager – Cyber Consulting Services to lead regulatory compliance advisory engagements, ensuring robust compliance frameworks and data protection. Oversee engagement teams, manage client relationships, and deliver high-quality, regulation-aligned solutions. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong compliance and team leadership skills.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Manager – GRC Services (Compliance) leads the delivery of regulatory compliance advisory engagements, helping clients establish, assess and strengthen their compliance frameworks, including regulatory compliance and data protection and conduct compliance programmes. Reporting to the Director – GRC Services, the role manages engagement teams, serves as a key client contact, and supports the growth of the compliance proposition while ensuring high-quality, regulation-aligned delivery.

Responsibilities:


Plan and deliver compliance advisory engagements, including compliance framework design, regulatory gap assessments, policy and procedure development and compliance monitoring programmes.

• Assess client compliance against applicable laws and regulations (e.g. Central Bank of the UAE, SCA, DFSA/DIFC, FSRA/ADGM, data-protection regulations) and international standards.

• Design and implement compliance governance structures, risk assessments, controls and reporting mechanisms.

• Manage engagement scope, budgets, timelines, quality and deliverables, escalating matters to the Director where required.

• Serve as a primary contact for compliance and risk stakeholders within client organizations.

• Communicate complex regulatory requirements and findings in a clear, practical and actionable manner.

• Lead, review and develop the work of consultants and analysts on compliance engagements.

• Allocate resources and manage workloads across multiple concurrent engagements.

• Support proposals, scoping and pricing for compliance opportunities and identify follow-on work.

• Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into client opportunities and offerings.

• Lead and develop a team of assessors and GRC analysts, including coaching, calibration, and quality reviews.

• Maintain assessor training, certification, and inter-rater reliability programs.

Skills : -

• Strong regulatory and compliance technical skills, including data protection.

• Project and engagement management, including scope, budget and quality control.

• Client relationship management and clear, persuasive communication.

• Team leadership and coaching skills.

Tools Experience : -

• GRC and compliance platforms (e.g. ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer or equivalent).

• Reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and advanced Excel for compliance reporting.

• Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity and collaboration suites

Qualifications:


Education & Minimum Work Experience : -

• Minimum 7 years of relevant compliance experience, including experience in a consulting, advisory, regulator or in-house compliance environment.

• Minimum 2 years managing compliance engagements and teams end to end.

• Demonstrated experience with compliance framework design, regulatory gap assessment.

• Experience advising on or supporting national / sector-wide cyber governance, assessment and compliance programmes — such as the National Cybersecurity Index Program — including evidence validation, assessment governance, remediation tracking and regulatory reporting, is strongly preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Risk Management, or a related field.

• Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Become part of our team as a Principal Software Engineer, leading technical strategy and architecture for web-scale platforms. Drive system-level design, mentor senior engineers, and ensure best practices in a fast-paced, agile environment. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong full stack and platform engineering expertise.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to lead end-to-end technical strategy, architecture, and execution across web-scale, platforms. This individual will be instrumental in defining system-level patterns, enforcing engineering best practices, and mentoring senior engineers within a fast-paced, agile environment. Will be leading our critical components of our AI platform and provide technical leadership across projects.

Responsibilities:


• Architect and build scalable platform systems (frontend platforms, backend services, and shared infrastructure)
• Develop reusable UI frameworks, design systems, and component libraries
• Design and maintain platform APIs and shared services used across multiple products
• Establish and drive platform engineering best practices (modularity, observability, reliability, and security)
• Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, internal developer platforms, and automation tooling
• Improve developer experience (DevEx) by reducing friction in development, testing, and deployment
• Ensure high availability, performance, and scalability across distributed systems
• Mentor engineers and guide teams in adopting platform capabilities effectively

Qualifications:


To qualify for the role, you must have

• 12–15+ years of experience in software engineering with strong full stack and platform engineering expertise
• Strong experience building shared platforms, frameworks, or internal tooling
• Proficiency in front-end technologies (React, Angular) and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
• Strong backend experience (Node.js, Python, or Go) with API and service design at scale
• Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and platform architectures
• Experience with API design (REST/gRPC), service contracts, and versioning strategies
• Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and platform-native services
• Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and orchestration at scale
• Experience with observability tools (monitoring, logging, tracing) is a plus

AI & Agentic Systems Expertise:

• Experience designing and building AI agent workflows and orchestration systems
• Familiarity with LLM-based applications, prompt design, and tool-augmented agents
• Experience integrating AI agents with APIs, services, and enterprise workflows
• Understanding of agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
• Experience with multi-agent systems, task planning, and workflow automation
• Knowledge of evaluation, guardrails, and reliability patterns for AI systems
• Exposure to RAG pipelines, vector databases, and context management is a plus

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.category: Data Analytics/Business Intelligence and Data Science
jobs.summary: We are expanding our team: As an Applied Scientist, you will drive research and development in AI, focusing on deep-learning and generative AI algorithms. Collaborate with product teams to deliver innovative solutions across diverse industries. Ideal for candidates with significant experience in AI algorithm development and a strong background in computer science or related fields.
jobs.description:
Overview:


Abu Dhabi

Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview

Inception is seeking a highly proficient and accomplished Applied Scientist, with a proven track record, to develop efficient deep-learning and generative AI algorithms and conceive innovative AI-centric models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with our product development teams, applying emerging technologies across a diverse range of applications.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

In the Applied Scientist role you will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. Your work will involve the creation and optimization of cutting-edge AI algorithms and deep learning models, contributing to advancements in areas such as semantic understanding, multidimensional data interpretation, and human-machine interactions. Furthermore, your innovative efforts will be applied to a spectrum of practical use cases, serving pivotal industries such as finance, oil and gas, environmental science, and healthcare, thereby driving forward the frontier of impactful AI solutions in real-world scenarios.

• Engage in the design, analysis and optimization of foundational and applied research to power the state-of-the-art AI algorithms and model capabilities at Inception. This will involve staying well-informed of emerging trends, understanding and manipulating complex datasets, and conceptualizing models that are both innovative and applicable to real-world scenarios.

• Work on comprehensive solutions that integrate various modalities, including text, audio, and visual data, enhancing the AI's ability to understand and interpret human interaction in a more nuanced manner.

• Collaborate with researchers and engineers across teams at Inception for the design, development, and continual improvement of AI algorithms, ensuring the implementations of such algorithms are optimized for efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Work alongside product development teams to integrate new algorithms and models into broader product offerings, and conduct proofs of concept (POC) as per client needs, ensuring that these innovations translate into tangible benefits for users and stakeholders.

• Propose scenarios where AI techniques could improve the efficiency of the customer’s business.

• Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

The criteria for your success would include cost savings achieved, number of use cases investigated & datasets mined, number of innovations/POCs deployed, number of existing processes optimized, and customer NPS.

To qualify, you must have

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.

• Minimum 6 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities

• Track record of conducting high-level research, preferably evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals or a history of product-driven research and development.

Ideally, you’ll also need

• A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving

• In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning

• Excellent communication skills

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Lead SOC Engineer (SIEM) (CPX)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Exciting opportunity for a seasoned SOC Lead Engineer to drive technical leadership and SIEM architecture within the Security Operations Centre. Oversee SIEM solutions, guide engineers, and support pre-sales estimations. Ideal for candidates with extensive SIEM expertise and strong leadership in cybersecurity environments.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The SOC Lead Engineer, SIEM has a vital role in the SOC that encompasses technical leadership, SIEM architecture design, and pre-sales support. This position is responsible for overseeing the management and coordination of SIEM solutions, within the Security Operations Center (SOC). The SOC Lead Engineer will guide senior and junior engineers in day-to-day operations across multiple environments and customers, while also assisting in pre-sales estimations of SIEM licenses. Reporting to the Senior SOC Engineering & Architecture Manager, the SOC Lead Engineer, SIEM is a seasoned professional with over a decade of experience in SIEM operations.

Responsibilities:


• Lead the technical operations and management of SIEM tools including Splunk, Sentinel, LogRhythm,Qradar and FortiSIEM.
• Oversee the maintenance and functionality of the log collection layer, with a focus on tools like CRIBL.
• Ensure the health and functionality of SIEM systems through regular checks and maintenance activities.
• Oversee and manage SIEM licenses, including forecasting, tracking usage, and coordinating with sales for estimations and renewals.
• Optimize SIEM telemetry to ensure efficient and accurate data collection, correlation, and reporting.
• Develop and enforce logging standards across all customers, systems and platforms to maintain consistent and reliable log data
• Provide guidance and mentorship to SOC Engineers in managing and resolving issues related to SIEM services and log management.
• Participate in pre-sales activities to provide technical expertise and estimation for SIEM licenses and architectures.
• Collaborate with SOC Engineering & Architecture Manager to develop SIEM architecture strategies and implement initiatives.
• Assist in continuous process improvements to increase SOC efficiency and effectiveness.
• Provide regular and accurate reporting on SIEM services, SOC operations, and license management to relevant stakeholders.

Skills:

• Extensive knowledge and hands-on experience with SIEM tools such as Splunk, Sentinel, LogRhythm, FortiSIEM, and log collection components like CRIBL.
• Proven technical leadership skills in a complex, fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrable pre-sales experience, particularly in estimating SIEM licenses.
• Strong understanding of SOC operations, cybersecurity principles, and best practices.
• Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions under pressure.
• Excellent mentorship and team development capabilities.
• High proficiency in written and verbal communication.

Qualifications:


Certifications:

• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
• Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
• Splunk Certified Architect or similar SIEM certifications are a must.
• Cloud-related certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• Networking certifications such as CCNA or CCNP are advantageous.

Educational Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
• A minimum of 10 years of experience in SIEM and SOC operations, with significant experience in SIEM management and architecture.
• Prior leadership role experience within a SOC or similar cybersecurity environment.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - OT Cybersecurity
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Join us as a Senior Engineer - OT Cybersecurity to design and implement cybersecurity solutions for utility and control centre environments. Lead hands-on deployment and integration of OT cyber infrastructure, ensuring compliance with industry standards. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in OT, instrumentation, and utility environments.
jobs.description:
Overview:


We are seeking highly skilled Engineers / / Senior Engineer / Lead Engineer to support the implementation of OT Cybersecurity solutions across utility environment and master control centers. The role involves hands-on deployment, configuration, and integration of cybersecurity technologies, infrastructure design, commissioning, and documentation. Candidates must have a strong background in operational technology (OT), instrumentation, and experience working in high and low voltage substations.

Responsibilities:


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design and develop High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents for OT cybersecurity infrastructure.
• Perform OT Cybersecurity Gap assessment , risk assessments as per IEC 62443 , NIST and international standards .
• Perform cable routing and physical installation of network and security devices in substations and control centers.

Engineering Design (HLD/LLD) & Drawing Development

• Review and validate Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), existing as-built drawings, and brownfield constraints; raise RFIs and propose constructible solutions.
• Validate panel drawings (GA, internal layout, wiring, interconnection, termination schedules, BOM) and ensure “as-built” updates post commissioning.
• OT Cybersecurity Infrastructure Deployment & Integration
• Implement and integrate OT cyber infrastructure components (e.g., industrial firewalls, switches, IDS sensors, secure remote access, logging collectors) according to approved LLD and standards.
• Support network cutovers, IP schemes, VLAN/VRF mapping, routing design inputs, and secure connectivity between substations and central platforms.
• Ensure installations meet required security baselines and customer utility practices (documentation, labeling, ports, hardening inputs).

Testing, FAT/SAT, Commissioning & Acceptance

• Support/lead FAT preparation and execution: test procedures, inspection checklists, configuration verification, and evidence packs.
• Execute SAT / site commissioning, including pre-checks, power-up, connectivity validation, link testing, redundancy checks, punch lists/snags, and final handover.
• Coordinate with OEMs and customer operations for outage windows, access approvals, and acceptance criteria signoffs.

.

Qualifications:


(Technical & Non-Technical)

Technical Skills / Core Competencies

• Demonstrated on-site execution in brownfield substations / utility environments (HV/LV interfaces awareness, safe work in operational sites).
• Strong capability in panel/cabinet build supervision, cabling, termination practices, labeling, testing, and as-built documentation.
• Proven ability to prepare HLD/LLD, implementable drawings, and engineering documentation packs.
• Understanding of OT network architecture principles (segmentation, zones/conducts), and integration constraints in utilities.
• Experience supporting FAT/SAT and commissioning activities with structured evidence and acceptance documentation.
• HSE / Compliance (Mandatory or Highly Preferred)
• Strong working knowledge of PTW systems, method statements and risk assessments for live utility sites
• Familiarity with UAE utility HSE expectations including OSHAD-aligned requirements and client safety governance.
•

Minimum Work Experience

• 7–12 years in cyber infrastructure / OT infrastructure / electrical-telecom execution in utilities, substations, rail, or industrial environments.
• Proven track record delivering brownfield site implementation including cabling/panels and commissioning support.
• Experience in data center infrastructure (rack/cabling/network build) supporting cyber platforms is a strong advantage.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering / Electronics / Instrumentation / Telecom / Computer Engineering (or equivalent relevant discipline)..
• Relevant OT cybersecurity certifications (at least one):

• ISA 62443 , GICSP ,CISSP

jobs.title: Security Delivery Consultant
jobs.description:
As a Security Delivery Specialist, you will act as a subject-matter expert across Security Operations, Incident Response, SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response, and Network Detection and Response. You will lead complex security investigations, enhance detection capabilities, administer critical security platforms and guide team members in delivering effective cybersecurity operations.

You will work with security engineering, infrastructure, network and business stakeholders to continuously improve cyber defense processes, technologies and reporting.

What You’ll Do

Incident Response & SOC Operations

• Develop, maintain and continuously improve Incident Response plans, SOC policies, processes, procedures and operational playbooks.
• Lead the detection, triage, investigation, containment and response to complex cybersecurity events and incidents.
• Analyze security events and telemetry to determine their nature, scope, severity and potential business impact.
• Provide technical direction and guidance to team members throughout investigations and response activities.
• Coordinate escalations and ensure incidents are handled according to established procedures and service requirements.
• Participate in on-call and after-hours security support when required.
• Identify lessons learned from security incidents and translate them into improvements across people, process and technology.

SIEM & Detection Engineering

• Work closely with SIEM engineers and other cybersecurity teams to develop, refine and optimize security-monitoring use cases.
• Create and tune correlation and detection rules using telemetry from SIEM, EDR, NDR and other security technologies.
• Analyze alerts, logs and security events to identify malicious activity, behavioral anomalies and emerging threats.
• Review existing detection logic and recommend improvements to increase detection effectiveness and reduce false positives.
• Identify monitoring gaps and support the development of new detection scenarios.
• Support the integration of EDR, NDR and other security platforms with enterprise SIEM technologies.

EDR Administration

• Administer and optimize enterprise Endpoint Detection and Response technologies.
• Deploy, upgrade and maintain EDR agents across Windows, macOS and Linux environments.
• Monitor agent health, coverage and connectivity, and troubleshoot endpoints that are not reporting correctly.
• Develop, implement and maintain EDR policies and configurations.
• Integrate EDR platforms with SIEM and other cybersecurity technologies.
• Review EDR configurations periodically and recommend enhancements to improve endpoint security coverage and detection capabilities.
• Manage platform-related support tickets and coordinate with technology vendors through resolution.

NDR Administration

• Administer and optimize enterprise Network Detection and Response technologies.
• Develop, implement and maintain NDR policies, configurations and monitoring rules.
• Integrate NDR platforms with SIEM and the broader security technology ecosystem.
• Develop and maintain custom correlation rules using EDR, NDR and other security telemetry.
• Monitor platform health and troubleshoot technical, connectivity and reporting issues.
• Periodically assess existing NDR configurations and recommend improvements to enhance network visibility and threat detection.

Cyber Intelligence, Reporting & Leadership

• Collaborate across SOC, security engineering, infrastructure, network, application and business teams.

What You’ll Need

• Strong experience in Security Operations and Incident Response.

• Hands-on experience using security tools and technologies for detection, investigation and response.
• Strong knowledge of Security Information and Event Management technologies.
• Experience developing, refining and tuning SIEM correlation or detection rules.
• Hands-on experience administering enterprise EDR and NDR platforms.
• Experience deploying and maintaining EDR agents across Windows, macOS and Linux.
• Experience integrating EDR and NDR platforms with SIEM and other security technologies.
• Strong understanding of security-event analysis, alert triage, incident investigation and response.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting and organizational capabilities.
• Ability to lead technical investigations and provide clear guidance to team members.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to communicate both technical and strategic cybersecurity matters to diverse audiences.
• Strong documentation, cyber intelligence reporting and stakeholder-management capabilities.
• Ability to participate in on-call or after-hours support when required.

Bonus Points If You Have

• GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON)

Location: Abu Dhabi

About Presight

Presight is an ADX-listed public company with Abu Dhabi based G42 as its majority shareholder and is the region’s leading big data analytics company powered by GenAI. It combines big data, analytics, and AI expertise to serve every sector, of every scale, to create business and positive societal impact. Presight excels at all-source data interpretation to support insight-driven decision-making that shapes policy and creates safer, healthier, happier, and more sustainable societies. Today, through its range of GenAI-driven products and solutions, Presight is bringing Applied AI to the private and public sector, enabling them to realize their AI strategy and ambitions faster.

The Opportunity:

Presight is seeking a strongly customer-focused, self-driven and results-oriented Full Stack Engineer.

Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities:

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will work within the development team to build the annotation platform on both sides front-end and back-end. Collaborating with Product Managers, Architects and Software Engineers to research, design, implement and improve functionalities of the annotation platform as part of a Big Data analytic system.

Functional

• Own scoped features end to end: from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, release, and production follow-up.
• Build responsive, accessible interfaces for annotation and data-review workflows.
• Develop backend services, RESTful APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows.
• Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering to clarify requirements, address edge cases, and deliver complete user journeys.
• Use AI development tools to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while remaining accountable for quality.
• Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, and apply security, privacy, performance, and reliability practices.
• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and improve features based on production behavior and user feedback.
• Follow applicable company policies and engineering standards.
• Comply with QHSE (Quality Health Safety and Environment), Business Continuity, Information Security, Privacy, Risk, Compliance Management and Governance of Organizations policies, procedures, plans and related risk assessments.

Qualifications
Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering or related field.
• Strong computer science and basic algorithms knowledge.
• 3+ years of professional software development experience, including delivering features across frontend and backend.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Change and Release
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: We are expanding our team: As a Senior Specialist - Change and Release, you will independently manage and coordinate changes and releases, ensuring predictability and risk mitigation. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain release readiness and communicate effectively. Ideal candidates bring strong experience in production change coordination and release management.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview

Enable Inception42 to introduce changes and releases safely, predictably and at the pace a product company needs. You will coordinate change risk, release readiness and communication across services supporting internal teams and external customers.

This is a senior practitioner role with independent responsibility for assigned changes and releases. You will make controls practical, evidence-based and proportionate to risk, working closely with the teams building and operating the products.

Works with the Lead Specialist, IT Service Management, Product Engineering, Quality Engineering, Application Support, Platform Reliability, Infrastructure and Information Security.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

• Operate and improve change enablement and release practices, applying agreed policies and escalating exceptions to the appropriate decision owner.

• Review changes for customer impact, dependencies, risk, testing evidence, implementation steps and recovery readiness. Ensure the right owners make and record approval decisions.

• Maintain standard, normal and emergency change paths. Develop pre-authorised change models with clear eligibility criteria and review their ongoing suitability.

• Coordinate release plans and calendars across teams, identifying shared-service conflicts, business constraints and dependencies early.

• Confirm release readiness with Engineering, Quality and Support, including acceptance evidence, known issues, configuration and data changes, runbooks and support handover.

• Facilitate go/no-go decisions and targeted change reviews; record decisions and unresolved risks with accountable owners.

• Agree deployment validation, rollback or recovery criteria, including situations where database or data changes cannot be simply reversed.

• Work with engineering teams to capture change and release evidence from delivery pipelines and repositories, reducing manual duplication while preserving traceability.

• Coordinate release notes, maintenance notices and stakeholder updates. Explain expected impact, timing and support arrangements in language users can understand.

• Track post-release health and early-life support with operational teams. Coordinate recovery decisions and incident handover when changes cause service degradation.

• Review failed and emergency changes, track corrective actions and report on change failure, approval delays, release predictability and recovery performance.

• Within the first six months: Change paths, decision authorities and release readiness expectations are clear and in consistent use; Assigned releases have visible dependencies, communication plans and tested recovery arrangements; A baseline exists for change outcomes, approval delays and release-related incidents.

• Within the first twelve months: Changes and releases demonstrate improved predictability and fewer avoidable failures against agreed baselines; Routine changes flow efficiently through approved models and automated evidence capture; Post-release learning results in visible improvements to testing, readiness and recovery.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• Strong practical experience coordinating production changes and software releases across multiple technical teams.

• Working knowledge of ITIL change enablement and release management, with evidence of applying controls proportionate to risk.

• Understanding of software delivery lifecycles, version control, CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion, testing and deployment approaches.

• Ability to challenge incomplete release plans, dependency assessments and rollback assumptions while working constructively with engineers.

• Experience maintaining change records and release evidence in ITSM and engineering tools, with accurate reporting and follow-through.

• Clear written and verbal communication, strong planning skills and sound judgement during incidents, conflicting priorities and time-sensitive decisions.

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting a SaaS or product business with frequent releases and customer service commitments.

• Exposure to feature flags, progressive rollout, automated validation and database migration controls.

• Relevant ITIL, Agile or DevOps qualifications backed by practical release experience.

Participates in agreed release windows and exceptional out-of-hours change or recovery activity, coordinated with the relevant delivery and support teams.

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jobs.summary: Become part of our team as a Lead SOC Engineer, delivering SIEM and SOAR management services within the Security Operations Centre. Oversee Splunk SIEM and SOAR, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure optimal system performance. Ideal for experienced SOC professionals with strong Splunk expertise.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Lead Engineer – SOC (SIEM & SOAR) is a critical role responsible for delivering SIEM /SOAR management services, particularly focusing on Splunk SIEM and SOAR, within the Security Operations Center (SOC). This role encompasses working closely with the SOC Internal and external teams to facilitate onboarding new log sources, enhancing and optimizing telemetry, ensuring system updates, resolving issues, and maintaining SIEM performance, automation and orchestration, designing playbooks according to best practices achieved through SOAR Solution.

Responsibilities:


Key Responosibilities

• Deliver Splunk SIEM /SOAR management services within the SOC environment.
• Collaborate with the asset owner, client stakeholder, and SOC, in onboarding new log sources to the SIEM/SOAR platform.
• Maintain and govern SOC critical log sources, ensuring their proper functionality and integration with Splunk SIEM /SOAR.
• Detect log source issues, coordinate with customers to diagnose and resolve them in a timely manner.
• Enhance and optimize telemetry within the Splunk environment to improve data collection, correlation, and reporting.
• Perform regular system updates to ensure Splunk functionality and security are up to date.
• Resolve Splunk-related issues promptly and efficiently.
• Proficiency in field extractions, data normalization, and CIM (Common Information Model) compliance.
• Maintain the performance of the Splunk SIEM /SOAR according to established best practices.
• Design SOAR Playbooks to enhance automation and orchestration of incidents.
• Connect SOAR with SIEM, ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow), threat intelligence platforms, and endpoint tools.
• Experience with platforms like Splunk SOAR (Phantom), Forti SOAR, or Cortex XSOAR.
• Participate in continuous process improvements to increase SOC efficiency and effectiveness.
• Provide regular and accurate reports on Splunk services and SOC operations to relevant stakeholders.
• Contribute to SOC architecture strategy and implementation initiatives related to Splunk.
• Assist in the mentorship and development of junior SOC engineers.

Characteristics:

• Profound knowledge and hands-on experience with Splunk SIEM/SOAR and other related technologies like CRIBL.
• Understanding of SOC workflows, MITRE ATT&CK framework, and threat detection methodologies.
• Ability to correlate data across multiple sources to identify patterns and anomalies.
• Strong understanding of cloud and network technologies, essential for efficient log source onboarding.
• Proven technical capabilities in a complex, fast-paced SOC environment.
• Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot log source issues related to cloud and network infrastructures.
• Strong understanding of SOC operations, cybersecurity principles, and best practices.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions under pressure.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with a variety of team members, including interfacing with customers to resolve issues.
• High proficiency in written and verbal communication.

Qualifications:


Skills/Certifications

• Splunk Certified Architect or Splunk Certified Administrator.
• Mastery of SPL (Search Processing Language) for complex queries, dashboards, and reports.
• Python scripting skills.
• Experience with platforms like Forti SOAR, Splunk SOAR (Phantom), Cortex XSOAR etc.
• Cloud-related certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC is preferred
• Networking certifications such as CCNA or CCNP are advantageous.

Minimum Work Experience

A minimum of 8 years of experience in SOC operations, with significant experience in Splunk SIEM management.

Prior experience in a technical role within a SOC or similar cybersecurity environment.
