Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Embedded Software Engineer

Role Overview:
Develop and maintain embedded software for aerospace and UAV systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with safety standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Design, develop, and test embedded software in C/C++.

• Develop software for real-time and safety-critical systems.

• Integrate software with hardware components, sensors, and actuators.

• Implement control algorithms and optimize code performance.

• Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and system testing.

• Maintain technical documentation and support certification activities.

• Collaborate with hardware, systems, and QA teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• 5–7+ years of embedded software development experience.

• Strong proficiency in C/C++ and embedded systems.

• Experience with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, VxWorks, QNX).

• Knowledge of hardware-software integration and communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN).

• Familiarity with aerospace/safety standards such as DO-178C and DO-254.

• Experience with Git and software debugging tools.

• Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Aerospace, defense, automotive, or other safety-critical industry experience.

• Relevant embedded systems or aerospace certifications.

locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Seeking a Senior Manager - Investment AI Platform to lead the (in)Alpha product team, translating investment processes into product requirements and standards. Drive product development and client-facing investment expertise. Ideal for experienced practitioners with deep investment domain knowledge and strong analytical skills.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


We are looking for a Senior Manager - Investment AI Platform to serve as the resident investment practitioner within the (in)Alpha product team. You will translate how investment professionals screen opportunities, run diligence, prepare committee materials, and monitor portfolios into product requirements and clear standards for analytical quality.

You will work closely with product, engineering, AI, growth, and client investment teams. The role combines deep product contribution with a substantial client-facing remit, representing (in)Alpha as a credible peer to private equity, private credit, venture, sovereign wealth, and other institutional investors.

This is a permanent, full-time individual-contributor role with significant influence over the platform and no direct reports at hire. You will operate in a fast-moving product environment where priorities evolve and strong judgment, precise communication, and high ownership are essential.

What You’ll Own


• Define how (in)Alpha modules should behave against real investment practice, including screening, diligence workstreams, data-room handling, investment committee materials, and portfolio monitoring and reporting.
• Author and maintain the reference artefacts that guide product development, including model investment committee memos, diligence question sets, decision criteria, scoring frameworks, and peer-benchmarking conventions.
• Work through backlog refinement with product and engineering, resolving practitioner-level questions on scope, behaviour, and edge cases before features are built.
• Pressure-test proposed features against fund governance, regulated processes, committee dynamics, and judgment-led decisions; identify where a workflow will fail in real deal-team use.
• Review AI-generated memos, summaries, comparables, extracted metrics, and monitoring insights for analytical soundness, appropriate treatment of uncertainty, and correct use of source evidence.
• Define the quality bar for each analytical output and work with the AI team to translate investment judgment into evaluation criteria that can be tested consistently across releases.
• Identify plausible but incorrect outputs, including misread covenants, misstated valuation logic, and false peer matches, and drive each issue to resolution with clear ownership.
• Set standards for citation, traceability, and source transparency so analysts can defend platform-generated figures and conclusions in front of an investment or credit committee.
• Lead the investment-domain contribution to product demonstrations, discovery sessions, and executive conversations with funds, sovereign wealth institutions, and other investors.
• Run design-partner relationships end to end, eliciting workflow detail at the level of individual artefacts and converting evidence into prioritized product input.
• Support deployments by advising client teams on how to configure templates, taxonomies, decision criteria, and existing diligence or committee processes within the platform.
• Contribute domain substance to proposals, RFP responses, and thought-leadership material in support of commercial teams, without direct ownership of the revenue target.
• Maintain a practitioner’s view of the competitive landscape and GCC market requirements, including regional deal structures & reporting conventions.
• Bring structured client evidence into roadmap and pricing discussions, and establish durable workflow references and evaluation standards that reduce avoidable output defects and product rework.

What We’re Looking For


• Substantial experience, typically 6+ years, in private equity, private credit, growth equity, or an institutional or sovereign investment environment, with direct ownership of transactions from sourcing through diligence and investment committee review.
• Demonstrable experience preparing and defending investment committee materials, including memo authorship, valuation and LBO analysis, and management of diligence workstreams.
• Working command of core investment-process artefacts, including data rooms, diligence trackers, peer benchmarking, decision frameworks, and portfolio reporting packs.
• Strong investment judgment and analytical scepticism, with the ability to distinguish decision-relevant evidence from interesting detail and detect credible-sounding but incorrect outputs.
• Ability to explain investment reasoning precisely to engineers, AI practitioners, designers, commercial teams, and client executives without diluting its analytical meaning.
• A track record of shaping decisions through evidence and persuasion in cross-functional, advisory, or committee settings without relying on formal authority.
• Comfort operating in an early-stage product environment where processes are still being defined, priorities can move, and progress depends on sound judgment and direct communication.
• Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, or a comparable discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Experience at a general partner, sovereign wealth fund, or regional institutional investor.
• Prior involvement in a technology, data, or transformation initiative within an investment firm, such as an internal deal-management, diligence, or reporting platform.
• A CFA or CAIA charter, or active progress toward one.
• Experience across both private equity and private credit workflows.
• Hands-on use or formal evaluation of AI-assisted research, diligence, or document-analysis tools.

Closing

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Position Summary
Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates. In line with UAE regulations, Emirati candidates are encouraged to apply.

New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) seeks to appoint a Assistant Director, IT Experience and Service Delivery reporting to the Director, IT Operations and Service Management.

The Assistant Director, IT Experience and Service Delivery leads the delivery and continual improvement of NYU Abu Dhabi’s primary end-user facing technology service capability. The role is responsible for ensuring faculty, students, staff, researchers, residents, visitors, guests, and campus partners receive consistent, responsive, professional, and user-centered technology support across academic, research, residential, administrative, instructional, meeting-room, public-computing, and event environments.

The portfolio encompasses Client Services, including the IT Experience Center and on-site support across workspaces, instructional, meeting-room and special spaces; endpoint and end-user technology service delivery; Event Services; Community Services; Residential technology support; and VIP and high-touch support. The role brings these capabilities together within an integrated service-delivery model with clear ownership, standards, escalation paths, performance measures, and accountability for the quality of the end-user technology experience and journey.

The Assistant Director leads a blended IT Experience & Service Delivery organization consisting of NYUAD service leads together with managed services providers and external support providers. The role maintains institutional accountability for service quality regardless of delivery model, ensuring internal and external teams operate as a coordinated organization against common service expectations, processes, performance measures, and values.

Working within the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks established by the Director, IT Operations and Service Management, the Assistant Director translates service objectives into effective operating models, workforce plans, processes, standards, and continual-improvement initiatives. The role works closely with NYUAD IT teams, NYU global partners, vendors, and service providers to provide a cohesive technology experience across NYUAD.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead IT Experience & Service Delivery and the end-user technology experience

•
Lead the full portfolio of end-user facing technology services across NYU Abu Dhabi, establishing an integrated operating model model spanning Client Services, the IT Experience Center, academic technology and learning-space support, endpoint and end-user technology service delivery, Event Services, Community Services, residential technology support, and VIP and high-touch support

•
Translate the strategic direction and service expectations established by the Director, IT Operations and Service Management into operational plans, service standards, staffing models, performance expectations, and continual-improvement priorities

•
Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and performance oversight for NYUAD service leads and staff across the IT Experience & Service Delivery portfolio, while ensuring managed-services personnel operate as an integrated extension of the NYUAD IT Experience & Service Delivery organization. Maintain clear institutional ownership and accountability for service outcomes regardless of whether services are delivered by NYUAD employees, contractors, or managed-services partners

•
Ensure services provide a consistent, responsive, and professional experience across user communities, engagement channels and physical environments while appropriately responding to the distinct needs of faculty, students, researchers, administrative staff, residents, visitors, guests, and institutional leadership. Maintain accountability for the quality of the end-user journey, including communication, follow-up, escalation, and hand-offs where technical resolution depends on other resolver groups

•
Facilitate user onboarding interviews, targeted end-user training and office hours, as required, to promote technology adoption, strengthen user capability, and address emerging community needs

•
Represent IT Experience & Service Delivery in cross-functional IT planning and contribute operational expertise and user insight to departmental discussions regarding service strategy, operational priorities, technology adoption, service improvement and the overall technology experience

Lead Client Services, the IT Experience Center and learning-space support

• Lead Client Services and the IT Experience Center as NYUAD's primary on-campus, end-user facing Tier 1 capability, together with on-site and end-user technology support across workspaces, instructional rooms, meeting rooms, special spaces, and shared campus environments. Ensure effective intake, triage, resolution, escalation, communication, request fulfillment, classroom readiness, and first-line AV support
• Develop and maintain a tiered and integrated support model that emphasizes resolution at the earliest appropriate level, equips frontline teams with the knowledge, tools, and authority required to resolve a broad range of issues, works in close partnership with the Global IT Service Desk and provides clear and accountable escalation to service owners and specialist teams when needed
• Establish and maintain operating procedures, staffing and scheduling models, knowledge-management practices, service standards, quality measures, and performance expectations that support consistent and effective service delivery across walk-up, appointment-based, phone, email, portal, classroom, and other agreed user-facing support channels and campus environments
• Monitor service demand, response and resolution performance, first-contact and first-visit resolution, escalation trends, user satisfaction, walk-in wait times, appointment availability, room readiness, recurring issues, and other relevant service indicators. Use these insights to improve operational effectiveness, service quality, and the overall technology experience
• Advance guided self-service, knowledge-centered support, automation, remote-support capabilities, practical digital-enablement sessions, and other modern service-delivery approaches that improve accessibility, build user capability, increase resolution efficiency, and reduce avoidable support demand

Oversee endpoint and end-user technology service delivery

• Provide functional leadership for the end user facing delivery of endpoint and end-user computing services, including university-managed desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, software delivery, device provisioning, equipment lending, and associated end-user technologies
• Oversee the operational service lifecycle of end-user devices from provisioning and deployment through configuration, support, refresh coordination, asset management, and secure retirement, ensuring clear ownership and effective hand-offs with the teams responsible for underlying platform and engineering services
• Direct NYUAD staff, service leads, and managed-services personnel responsible for endpoint and user technology services, establishing clear standards, responsibilities, performance expectations, documentation requirements, and escalation practices
• Work closely with Infrastructure Services and Information Security, Technology Governance, and relevant engineering teams to ensure endpoint environments are standardized, securely managed, supportable, current, and appropriately responsive to academic, research, administrative, and specialized requirements
• Promote modern management practices including automated provisioning, endpoint-management platforms, proactive monitoring and remediation, remote support, software automation, and accurate asset and configuration information
• Ensure new or changed end-user technologies transition effectively into service with appropriate documentation, knowledge, support processes, training, tools, and escalation pathways

Drive service performance, continual improvement, and operational maturity

• Work closely with the Service Management function to implement ITSM standards, processes, performance measures, service reporting, and continual-improvement practices across the IT Experience & Service Delivery portfolio
• Establish and review a balanced set of SLAs, KPIs, service-quality measures, end-user experience indicators, and performance expectations across Client Services, the IT Experience Center, learning spaces, Event Services, Community Services, asset and equipment support, NYUAD teams and managed-services providers
• Analyze operational data, user feedback, recurring incidents, escalation patterns, support demand, vendor performance, and service trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, knowledge development, workforce optimization, and service redesign
• Promote participation in IT service surveys across the community and work with service owners to incorporate survey findings into service-improvement priorities and actions
• Participate actively in incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, major incident, service transition, and continual-improvement processes, ensuring the IT Experience & Service Delivery perspective and end-user impact are appropriately represented
• Ensure managed-services providers meet contractual and operational expectations and work with service leads, vendors, and the Director, IT Operations and Service Management to address performance gaps, capacity concerns, or systemic delivery issues
• Ensure IT Experience & Service Delivery teams are operationally ready to support new technologies and services prior to transition into production, including appropriate knowledge, documentation, support procedures, training, tools, workforce capacity, and escalation paths
• Promote a culture of accountability, service excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and data-informed decision-making across the IT Experience & Service Delivery organization

Lead Event Services and VIP/High-Touch Support

• Lead the delivery of AV and technology support for academic, institutional, leadership, and selected commercial events, including conferences, ceremonies, executive engagements, visiting dignitaries, strategic guests, and other high-visibility activities requiring coordinated technology services
• Establish repeatable event-technology service models based on the scale, complexity, visibility, and risk of individual events, including appropriate requirements capture, planning, staffing, technical rehearsals, readiness checks, onsite support, contingency handling, escalation, and post-event review
• Direct the work of NYUAD staff, technical leads, managed-services personnel, contractors, and external technology providers supporting events, ensuring responsibilities and accountability are clearly established
• Partner with event organizers, Events, Public Affairs, Communications, Facilities, Campus Services, academic and administrative units, Infrastructure Services, AV Infrastructure, and other relevant stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure technology services are appropriately planned and delivered
• Develop standards, procedures, service offerings, and support tiers that reduce dependence on ad hoc or individual-dependent practices while retaining the flexibility required for specialized, high-profile or institutionally critical activities
• Use event feedback and operational experience to continuously improve readiness, service quality, resource utilization, and the overall event technology experience

Lead Community Services and residential technology support

• Lead Community Services across NYUAD, including user-facing IT communications, support guidance, basic digital enablement, tool adoption, community engagement, and feedback capture, while retaining clear and effective technology support for the University's residential community
• Establish defined community-facing and residential technology service models with clear service boundaries, ownership, support channels, escalation pathways, performance expectations, communications service guides, and adoption support
• Provide operational direction and performance oversight for NYUAD and managed-services personnel delivering community-facing and residential technology support, ensuring consistent service standards and effective coordination with other IT teams
• Partner closely with Infrastructure Services, Student Affairs, Residential Education, Campus Services, Facilities, Information Security, academic units, and other relevant stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues, strengthen service communication and adoption, and improve the community technology experience
• Use service data, recurring issue analysis, self-service usage, user feedback, and engagement with faculty, students, researchers, staff, and residents to identify service gaps, improve support processes and guidance, and inform future technology and service improvements
• Ensure Community Services and residential technology support are integrated into the broader IT Experience & Service Delivery and IT Operations model rather than operating as a separate or ad hoc support functions

jobs.title: Manager - Cyber Consulting Services (CPX)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Join us as a Manager – Cyber Consulting Services (CPX) to lead risk management advisory engagements, designing and implementing enterprise risk frameworks for clients. Oversee team delivery, manage client relationships, and ensure high-quality outcomes. Ideal for experienced professionals with strong risk management expertise and leadership skills.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Manager – GRC Services (Risk Management) is responsible for the day-to-day delivery of risk management advisory engagements, leading engagement teams to design, implement and enhance enterprise and operational risk frameworks for clients. Reporting to the Director – GRC Services, the role combines hands-on technical delivery with team leadership, client relationship management and support to business development, ensuring engagements are delivered to a high standard, on time and within budget.

Responsibilities:


• Lead the assessment, design and implementation of operational, strategic, financial and emerging-risk frameworks aligned to ISO 31000, COSO ERM and relevant regulatory expectations. Plan, manage and deliver risk management engagements, including enterprise risk management (ERM) framework design, risk appetite and tolerance setting, risk and control self-assessments, key risk indicators and risk reporting

• Develop risk registers, heat maps, risk appetite statements, policies, procedures and governance structures tailored to client needs.

• Manage engagement scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables and quality, escalating issues to the Director as needed.

• Act as a primary day-to-day client contact, building strong working relationships with risk, audit and operational stakeholders.

• Present findings, recommendations and deliverables clearly to management and, where appropriate, board and committee audiences.

•Lead, coach and review the work of consultants and analysts, providing direction, feedback and on-the-job development.

• Manage resourcing and workload allocation across concurrent engagements

• Support proposal development, scoping and pricing for risk management opportunities.

• Identify follow-on and cross-service opportunities within existing accounts.

Skills : -

• Strong risk-management technical skills across ERM, operational and emerging risk.

• Project and engagement management, including scope, budget and quality control.

• Client relationship management and clear written and verbal communication.

• Team leadership and coaching skills.

Tools Experience : -

• GRC and risk management platforms (e.g. ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer or equivalent).

• Reporting and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) and advanced Excel for risk analytics and dashboards.

• Risk register, heat-map and KRI/KPI tooling.

• Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity and collaboration suites.

Qualifications:


Minimum Work Experience & Education

• Minimum 7 years of relevant risk-management experience, including experience in a consulting or advisory environment.

• Minimum 2 years managing engagement and teams end to end.

• Demonstrated experience designing or implementing ERM frameworks, risk appetite and control assessments.

• Experience supporting national / sector-wide cyber risk and maturity programmes — such as the National Cybersecurity Index Program — including cyber risk scoring, maturity assessment and KRI/KPI design, is strongly preferred.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

• Master’s degree preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Incident Response (CPX)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: We are looking for a Senior Manager - Incident Response (CPX) to lead a high-impact cyber defence team, overseeing technical execution and people management in a critical environment. The role requires deep expertise in digital forensics and incident response, with a focus on crisis management and technical leadership. Ideal for experienced professionals in IT security and incident response.
jobs.description:
Overview:


About the Role :-

As a Senior Manager of the Incident Response & Forensics Team within a high-impact and operationally critical cyber defence environment, you live and breathe blue team operations. Your technical expertise in digital forensics and cyber incident response is second only to your integrity and passion for cyber security and technology in general. In addition to the technical execution and oversight you will also own people management.

We want a leader with a strong technical understanding of how to respond to cyber-attacks and assist organisations with remediation and recovery. You must be able to execute technical assessments and incident response activities as a coordinator and main escalation point for crisis management as well as key decision maker. In this role you will be expected to get your hands dirty, from analysis tasks to emergency situations at critical industries.

Responsibilities:


Take ownership and oversight of a team who executes all aspects of reactive & proactive defensive security projects, including a DFIR Lab, for one on-site VIP customer

Perform the required duties of the Incident Response and Forensic Team’s Senior Manager (both people management and operational management duties)

Serve as technical lead on active incident response engagements across different sub-entities for this one VIP customer. Lead and execute the coordination, investigation and resolution of large-scale incidents following industry standard processes e.g. 800-61 r2 PICERL in a calm and methodical manner utilizing your strong technical skills

Execute, coordinate and lead threat hunting activities in support of incident response, as well as proactive environment assessments and SOC activities

Provide subject matter expertise in the threat detection and cyber defence domains

Take ownership of the DFIR Lab & service for this VIP on-site customer, contributing significantly in a leadership capacity, to process documentation and continuous service improvement activities

Lead and coordinate host and/or network-based forensics across various platforms

Lead and coordinate digital systems and mobile forensic investigations supporting cyber incident response engagements

Lead and coordinate the drafting of detailed reports and technical briefs, effectively communicating tasks, methodology and guidance to VIP on-site customer

Use your ability to stay calm and grounded in highly challenging situations to instil trust within client stakeholders; explain technical findings in a manner that can be easily understood by technical and non-technical stakeholders

Demonstrate industry thought leadership through internal brown-bag knowledge sharing sessions, coordinate the team’s topics for such sessions

Develop talent within the team by providing constructive and positive direction and support to achieve targets, build capabilities, and take on challenging DFIR & research projects

Lead research activities in search of service improvement tasks and better understanding of threat landscape.

lead and nurture a team culture built on trust, respect, appreciation, flexibility, and unity

Flexible schedule that is open to changing situations and opportunities, as with any position that is related to Incident Response

You must be a team player, with a humble and approachable nature who is willing to go the extra mile.

Ability to make an impact already after the initial couple of weeks of adapting into the new environment. Flexible schedule that is open to work in shifts (as per the team’s schedule) as well as changing situations and opportunities. There will be no working shift for this position, but the team’s shifts shall rotate from 6AM to 2PM and from 2PM to 10PM in a monthly basis, as a requirement to work for this important VIP on-site client, including on-call rotation as well of one week duration once every 2 months.

Technical Skills

Expert understanding of blue team operations and threat hunting

Deep understanding of digital forensics methodologies as well as usage of various tools

Expert understanding of network protocols, TCP/IP etc.

Expert understanding of network forensic principles and applications

Expert understanding of Microsoft Windows

Strong understanding of Linux and OSX

Expert understanding of enterprise IT and IT Security infrastructure. You will use this knowledge to lead strategic recommendations to customers, with the help of the DFIR Team, and ensure the best remediation of the managed incidents

Strong forensic skills across multiple operating systems

Proven experience performing duties utilising PICERL / NIST IR standards

Qualifications:


Strong attention to detail and reporting accuracy

Strong English language skills, both spoken and written

Minimum 10 Years dedicated to IT security, and/or security infrastructure experience

At least 6 years in a security role as part of an incident response team (CERT, CSIRT), including 4 years managing incident response teams, or equivalent blue teams (e.g. defence consulting, SOC, )

Previous experience performing digital forensics is A MUST

Scripting skills (Shell, Python, PowerShell) are a plus

Must have at least three of the following certifications, CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, GCFE, OSCP, GREM, GDAT or equivalent certifications as well as experience in the relevant domains

Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in computer science or information security desirable, but not mandatory. Experience in a similar position is still the most important factor.

locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Join our team as a Senior Technical Architect, shaping the architecture strategy for AI-driven initiatives. Lead technical decisions, drive innovation, and ensure scalable, secure solutions. Ideal for experienced professionals with deep expertise in technical architecture and a strong background in AI, cloud platforms, and large-scale technology leadership.
jobs.description:
Inception, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview:


As a Senior Technical Architect at Inception, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the overarching architecture strategy for our AI-driven initiatives. You will work across teams to align business objectives with technology strategies, drive technical-wide architectural decisions, and ensure our systems are scalable, secure, and aligned with best practices. Your expertise will be instrumental in driving innovation and ensuring the successful delivery of transformative AI solutions.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

• Develop and maintain the technical architecture framework to support business objectives and technology strategies.
• Lead the evaluation, selection, and integration of new technologies and frameworks across the organization.
• Provide strategic guidance and oversight for large-scale AI and technology initiatives.
• Design and oversee the implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance AI solutions.
• Mentor and guide architects and technical teams in best practices and innovative solutions.
• Monitor technology trends and advocate for the adoption of emerging technologies where applicable.

Required Tech Stack

• Technical Architecture: Deep experience with frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, or similar.
• Programming and Development: Proficiency in languages like Python, Java, and JavaScript, with a focus on technical-level solutions.
• AI and Machine Learning: Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and technical AI platforms.
• Cloud Platforms: Expertise in AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Data Management: Advanced knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases, and big data solutions (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).
• Microservices and Integration: Expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and service mesh technologies

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• Proven ability to lead technical-scale architectural transformations.
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and efficient architectures.
• Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
• A proactive, innovative mindset with a bias for action and continuous learning.

To qualify for the role you must have

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Extensive experience in technical architecture and technology leadership.
• Demonstrated success in delivering large-scale, AI-driven solutions.
• Deep understanding of architectural principles, system design, and technology strategy.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception community.

What Working At Inception Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

Software Engineer

jobs.title: Electrical Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Pulse Nova, one of EDGE's Joint Ventues, is lookign to hire an Electrical Integration Engineer who will be in charge of designing, developing, and validating the electrical integration of radar, EW, C2, and sensor systems onto naval, ground, and airborne platforms. The role involves defining power distribution, grounding, bonding, equipment mounting, and cable-routing solutions, while preparing electrical installation drawings and interconnection diagrams. The engineer will lead hardware installation activities, coordinate with technicians, and support electrical safety checks, system power-up, troubleshooting, and environmental qualification testing.

RESPONSIBILITIES


● Design and validate the electrical integration of radar, EW, C2, and sensor equipment onto naval, ground-vehicle, and airborne/UAS platforms.

● Define equipment racking, mounting, power distribution, grounding/bonding, and environmental protection solutions in line with MIL-STD-810G (or equivalent) requirements.

● Perform electrical interface analysis: weight and footprint budgets, power consumption, cooling, and vibration/shock loading per platform.

● Prepare electrical installation drawings, interconnection diagrams, and cable-routing plans.

● Lead and support the physical installation of hardware on each platform, coordinating directly with the installation technicians.

● Support electrical safety checks, power-up sequences, and troubleshooting of electromechanical issues during integration and trials.

● Support environmental and qualification testing (vibration, shock, ingress protection, thermal).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


● Degree in Electrical Engineering.

● Minimum 5+ years of experience in electrical integration of electronic equipment onto vehicles, vessels, or aircraft.

● PLC Programming in Platforms as Siemens, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, etc. HMI / SCADA Systems, Industrial Networks: Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP

● Knowledge of power distribution, grounding/bonding, and EMI shielding practices.

● Familiarity with MIL-STD-810G or equivalent environmental qualification standards.

● Experience with CAD tools for electrical layout.

● Hands-on experience with installation tooling, torque specifications, and workmanship standards.

● Willingness to travel to integration and test sites, including desert/field campaigns and naval facilities.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer GCS
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking an experienced Principal Software Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and verification of software for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Ground Control Station (GCS) systems. The role will focus on developing reliable, secure, and high-performance software supporting mission planning, command and control, flight monitoring, telemetry visualization, payload management, and real-time situational awareness.

The successful candidate will provide technical leadership in software architecture, HMI/UI development, system integration, and automated testing while collaborating closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams. This role requires strong expertise in C/C++, real-time and embedded systems, communication interfaces, and mission-critical software engineering, with a focus on system reliability, operational safety, cybersecurity, and mission effectiveness.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Lead the design, development, integration, testing, and maintenance of UAV Ground Control Station software.

• Develop and enhance software capabilities for mission planning, command and control, flight monitoring, telemetry visualization, vehicle health monitoring, alerts, payload control, video streaming, and map-based situational awareness.

• Lead the development of intuitive and reliable Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) and User Interfaces (UI) for mission operations and real-time vehicle monitoring.

• Integrate UAV autopilots, navigation systems, avionics, payload controllers, sensors, and communication systems with GCS applications.

• Design and implement reliable communication interfaces for RF, SATCOM, IP networks, and UAV datalinks, addressing latency, packet loss, communication interruptions, and degraded operating conditions.

• Develop real-time data processing capabilities for telemetry, navigation, video, payload information, and vehicle health monitoring.

• Define and maintain scalable, modular, maintainable, and high-performance software architectures.

• Lead code reviews, technical design reviews, software estimation, development planning, and engineering best practices.

• Develop and maintain automated testing frameworks covering unit, integration, system, simulation, and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex software, system integration, communication, and real-time performance issues during laboratory, field, and flight-test activities.

• Support requirements analysis, software verification and validation, configuration management, and technical documentation throughout the software development lifecycle.

• Contribute to cybersecurity hardening and the implementation of secure communication mechanisms for GCS applications.

• Ensure software development activities comply with applicable aerospace, defense, safety, quality, and interoperability standards.

• Collaborate with systems engineering, avionics, embedded software, networking, AI/autonomy, hardware, cybersecurity, testing, and flight operations teams.

• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to software engineers, promoting high standards of software quality, reliability, and engineering excellence.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Typically, 9-12+ years of relevant software engineering experience, preferably in UAV, aerospace, defense, robotics, embedded systems, or other mission-critical environments.

• Strong programming proficiency in C and C++ and practical experience developing complex software applications.

• Demonstrated experience developing UAV Ground Control Station software, mission planning systems, command-and-control applications, telemetry systems, payload control software, or comparable mission-critical applications.

• Experience in HMI/UI development, real-time data visualization, mission monitoring, and operator-facing software applications.

• Strong understanding of real-time and embedded software development, including ARM/STM32 platforms and RTOS environments.

• Experience with software architecture, object-oriented design, multithreading, concurrency, networking, and distributed systems.

• Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces, including UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, and IP networking.

• Experience integrating autopilots, navigation systems, sensors, avionics, payloads, and communication subsystems with software applications.

• Experience developing and executing automated unit, integration, system, and simulation tests.

• Familiarity with Linux and Windows development environments.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical problem-solving, and system integration skills.

• Excellent technical communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Experience with RTOS platforms such as FreeRTOS, VxWorks, or QNX.

• Exposure to additional programming languages, including C#, Python, or Java.

• Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, simulation environments, and automated test infrastructure.

• Experience developing safety-critical or mission-critical software for aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems.

• Knowledge of DO-178C or other applicable aerospace software assurance and safety standards.

• Familiarity with NATO interoperability standards, particularly STANAG 4586.

• Experience with RF, SATCOM, and UAV datalink integration in operational environments.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure communications, and hardening of mission-critical software systems.

• Experience supporting UAV laboratory integration, field testing, flight testing, or operational deployment.

• Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and driving software architecture and engineering best practices.

• Familiarity with configuration management, requirements traceability, software verification and validation, and regulated engineering development processes.

Professional Certifications

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION:
Define and lead the strategic vision for Open API and Open Banking services across the enterprise, enabling secure, scalable, and innovative digital ecosystems. The role focuses on decomposing legacy systems into modular, reusable APIs, fostering third-party collaboration, and ensuring compliance with Open Banking regulations.
Drives platform modernization, developer enablement, and cross-functional alignment to accelerate digital transformation and customer-centric innovation. Ensure APIs are designed and managed as strategic digital assets that deliver measurable business value.

• Track and report KPIs related to API performance, adoption, and risk metrics.
• Promote DevSecOps, CI/CD, and test automation practices across the API lifecycle.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:
• Exp Overall: 12+ Years, Banking 8+ Years
• Deep understanding of Open Banking frameworks, API security (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and regulatory compliance.
• Strong experience in API management platforms (e.g., Apigee, Kong, WSO2).
• Expertise in RESTful API design, JSON, Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.
• Familiarity with domain-driven design and microservices architecture.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex stakeholder environments.
• Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.
• Proficiency in API analytics, usage tracking, and performance optimization.
• Experience with tools like API Management, Kong, Cloud Native Services, Kubernetes.

jobs.title: SAP Solutions Consultant
locations: Abu Dhabi, Sowwah Square - Al Sila Tower
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Consultant to lead and support the design, implementation, and optimisation of SAP solutions. The successful candidate will bring deep functional and/or technical expertise across SAP modules relevant to operations, including logistics, asset management, procurement, finance, and human resources. You will work closely with client stakeholders, programme managers, and technical teams to deliver mission-critical SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end SAP implementation and support projects
• Gather and translate complex business requirements into SAP functional and technical specifications
• Configure, test, and deploy SAP modules in line with SAP standards and regulatory frameworks
• Provide subject matter expertise across relevant SAP modules (listed below)
• Liaise with stakeholders to manage expectations and drive solution adoption
• Conduct workshops, training sessions, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
• Ensure data integrity, security compliance, and audit readiness across all SAP environments
• Contribute to solution architecture design and continuous improvement initiatives
• Manage and mentor junior consultants and client-side SAP teams

SAP Modules – Required Knowledge

Finance & Controlling

• SAP FI (Financial Accounting) – General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset accounting for assets
• SAP CO (Controlling) – Cost centre accounting, internal orders, project cost tracking
• SAP FM (Funds Management) – Budget management, commitment accounting aligned to regulatory spending controls
• SAP GM (Grants Management) – Funding from agencies
• SAP PSM (Public Sector Management) –Budget execution and compliance

Logistics & Supply Chain

• SAP MM (Materials Management) – Procurement, inventory management, catalogue management
• SAP WM / EWM (Warehouse / Extended Warehouse Management) – Depot management, spare parts logistics
• SAP IM (Inventory Management) – Stock control including serialised and batch-managed items
• SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) – Inter-agency sales, cross-charging, equipment loans and returns
• SAP TM (Transportation Management) – Movement of equipment, vehicles, and materiel
• SAP GTS (Global Trade Services) – Export controls, dual-use goods compliance, ITAR/EAR adherence

Plant Maintenance & Asset Management

• SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) – Equipment maintenance scheduling, corrective and preventive maintenance
• SAP EAM (Enterprise Asset Management) – Full lifecycle management of assets
• SAP CS (Customer Service) – Equipment repair and return management

Project & Programme Management

• SAP PS (Project System) – Management of acquisition projects, capital programmes, and R&D
• SAP PPM (Portfolio & Project Management) – Programme, resource planning, and milestone tracking

Human Resources & Workforce

• SAP HCM (Human Capital Management) – personnel records, payroll, absence management
• SAP SuccessFactors – Talent acquisition, performance management, and workforce planning

Quality & Compliance

• SAP QM (Quality Management) – Inspection lots, quality control, supplier qualification
• SAP GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) – Access control, audit management, segregation of duties, regulatory compliance

Analytics & Reporting

• SAP BW/4HANA – operational reporting and data warehousing
• SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) – Dashboards, KPIs, and mission readiness reporting

Technology & Integration

• SAP S/4HANA – Core ERP platform (on-premise or private cloud for classified environments)
• SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) – Integration, automation, and app development
• SAP PI/PO / Integration Suite – Middleware integration
• SAP Fiori – Role-based UX for field and operational users

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience (5+ years) delivering SAP solutions in highly regulated environments
• Deep functional expertise in at least three of the above SAP modules
• Understanding of procurement frameworks
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills at senior/executive level
• SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (desirable)

Desirable Requirements

• Knowledge of ITIL, PRINCE2, or Agile delivery methodologies
• Experience with SAP RISE or private cloud deployment
• Background in logistics, engineering, or programme management

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on high-impact programmes
• Professional development and SAP certification support
• [Pension / benefits / flexible working as applicable]

jobs.title: Security Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Accenture Technology Overview

Accenture Security helps organizations build cyber resilience through industry-leading security services, advanced technologies, and deep industry expertise. Our Cyber Defense capabilities support organizations in protecting critical assets, strengthening security operations, and enabling effective threat detection and response across complex enterprise environments.

Job Summary

As a Cybersecurity Service Delivery Manager, you will lead the delivery of SIEM logging and security monitoring enablement across complex enterprise environments. You will combine strong technical expertise in SIEM and log management with delivery leadership, ensuring security-relevant data is onboarded, normalized, validated, and optimized to support threat detection and monitoring objectives.

You will work closely with cybersecurity, application, infrastructure, and engineering teams to translate monitoring requirements into actionable logging strategies, drive structured onboarding initiatives, resolve data-quality challenges, and provide stakeholders with clear visibility into delivery progress, risks, and outcomes.

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Specialist, Security & Loss Prevention
jobs.summary: Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure
jobs.description:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Specialist. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities

• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility

• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards

• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external stakeholders (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters

• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards

A day in the life

As an SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

About the team

Sitting within the Global Security Operations organization, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazons business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could:

• Put our associates and customers under jeopardy

• Disrupt the continuity of our business operations

• Inflict damage to our assets

• Have adverse impact on our brand reputation

Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing reoccurrence.

Basic qualifications
- • Relevant security- or risk-related education or experience (e.g., security services, asset protection, loss prevention, risk management, inventory management, investigations, supply chain, auditing, compliance, or similar).

- • Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment.

- • Advanced proficiency in written and verbal Arabic.

- • Upper intermediate proficiency in written and verbal English.

Preferred qualifications
- • Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you..

- • A relevant degree, degree equivalent, or industry certification.

- • Relevant experience with physical security systems, investigation techniques, and/or management of contract security officers.

- • Relevant experience with retail, warehouse, distribution centre services, delivery service, or supply chain.

- • Relevant experience in working with data.

- • Driver’s license.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Principal Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Software Tester with a strong background in embedded systems and aviation-related software testing. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing software testing teams, writing and executing test cases, and be familiar with industry standards such as RTCA DO-178C. Experience in UAV systems and the QT framework is preferred. This role involves leading a team of software testers, ensuring adherence to software engineering processes, and delivering high-quality testing solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Lead and manage the software testing team to ensure timely and accurate delivery of test cases and execution.

• Design, write, and maintain comprehensive test cases based on software requirements and design documents.

• Execute test cases manually and through automation, ensuring that the software meets the functional, performance, and safety requirements.

• Collaborate closely with software development and product teams to understand and evaluate software systems.

• Ensure compliance with industry standards such as RTCA DO-178C, especially in safety-critical software environments.

• Manage the testing lifecycle from test planning, test execution, defect reporting, and test completion.

• Oversee testing processes in embedded systems and ensure compatibility with avionics or aviation-related systems.

• Provide leadership and mentorship to the testing team, encouraging best practices in test automation and continuous integration.

• Implement quality assurance strategies and continuously improve testing methodologies.

• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support system integration and validation efforts.

• Foster a collaborative, transparent, and goal-oriented work environment.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Computer Science, Electronics, or related field).

• Minimum 10 years of experience in software testing, with a focus on embedded systems.

• Proficiency in writing and executing test cases for both manual and automated testing.

• Experience working in embedded systems and familiarity with the QT framework.

• Strong understanding of software engineering processes (requirements, design, development, verification).

• In-depth knowledge of RTCA DO-178C and its application in safety-critical software testing.

• Experience with UAV systems (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles) is preferred.

• Proven experience in aviation software testing or embedded systems in aerospace applications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Technical and line management experience

• Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and tools.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies and test-driven development.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Abu Dhabi

Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Inception is seeking an accomplished Director of R&D in Applied AI, with a proven track record of directing multi-program applied research portfolios, to lead our applied AI research function. This role offers the rare opportunity to set the technical direction across multiple flagship programs in parallel — including a foundation language model family and multi-agent and agentic systems research— while providing oversight to high-stakes client delivery tracks that bring those research outputs into production.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

In the Director of R&D role you will own the active applied research portfolio of the function, set its technical direction, and represent it at executive and Board level. You will direct concurrent flagship programs in foundation language models and multi-agent systems, while overseeing client delivery tracks that productize those research outputs. You will be the named technical arbiter on release, IP and prioritization decisions, and the senior point of contact for our most strategic external partners.

o Own the active R&D portfolio end-to-end — research roadmap, milestones, resource allocation and quarterly reviews.

o Direct the foundation language model program end-to-end — pre-training, post-training (instruction tuning, alignment), evaluation (language quality, multilingual performance, and safety posture), and release.

o Provide oversight to high-stakes client and delivery tracks and run regular reviews with R&D team covering progress, blockers, and re-allocation decisions across active programs.

o Represent Inception R&D in CEO-, group-executive- and Board-level forums, with the ability to make impactful presentations.

o Own the most strategic external partnerships academic research partners, frontier-model labs, the hyperscaler partnership cadence, sister-organization safety teams, and evaluation and red-teaming vendors — and lead joint workstreams to closure.

o Lead a team of applied scientists and senior applied scientists through technical mentorship, performance and growth, hiring, and defining team shape and talent strategy.

o Set and enforce R&D quality standards across projects and teams.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

The criteria for your success would include the maturity of the R&D portfolio you direct, foundation-model releases shipped under your sign-off, the health and growth of the Applied Science team, the depth of strategic partnerships sustained, and the readiness of research outputs for executive and Board consumption.

o M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an AI-related field. Specialization in NLP, large language models, or applied ML is highly desirable.

o Minimum 10 years of experience in AI / ML, with at least 4 years in a technical leadership or director-level role directing multiple concurrent research programs.

o Demonstrated ownership of at least one production foundation-model release end-to-end.

o Strong publication record in major NLP / ML venues, or an equivalent product-driven research and IP-filing track record.

o Production experience with Arabic or other lower-resource-language NLP at scale.

o Experience deploying AI Models into regulated or government contexts, including content moderation and policy-aligned guardrails.

o Hands-on familiarity with agentic-AI architectures — planning, tool use, multi-agent simulation.

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


G42 is building the compute, cloud, and data foundations for advanced AI to work at scale across government, healthcare, energy, finance and more.

Within G42, Inception42 is the layer that turns infrastructure into products people actually use. Our mission is to make advanced AI reliable, sovereign, and genuinely useful for some of the most important institutions and companies in the world. Our agentic systems strive to carry out real work rather than simply answer questions: Alpha, InSight and Vantage are applications for domain-specific intelligence; and Catalyst, our agentic platform, serves organisations who build and run agents while keeping sensitive data within the UAE.

The opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Product Designer to lead design work and manage a design pod across our AI-native portfolio: personal AI agents, executive intelligence, agentic workflows, governance platforms, and domain-specific solutions.

This is a role for an inventor. Your central job is to translate abstract vision — an executive ambition, a policy goal, a model capability that appeared six months ago — into concrete, innovative products that people trust and use every day. Your work will define how people should delegate real work to autonomous systems, and stay in control of the outcomes achieved by AI that are inherently non-deterministic.

You will own design from discovery through delivery, set the craft bar and the design systems across multiple products, and redefine the product design best practices at Inception42. You will work at the boundary of design, product, and applied AI — shaping not only the interface, but how the AI behaves with it.

Responsibilities:


Vision and strategy

• Define the product design vision, experience principles, and quality bar across Inception42’s portfolio.
• Translate abstract vision and emerging AI capability into concrete, innovative product concepts — and then into shipped experiences.
• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Science teams to shape product strategy and roadmaps, for both the near term and the long term.
• Turn business and government requirements into use cases and high-level customer experiences.
• Drive sharper design thinking and seamless processes across Inception42

Building AI-native apps, not just interfaces

• Work fast and run several projects at once, comfortable with ambiguity while managing stakeholder input, functional requirements, and timelines.
• Lead discovery, UX research, journey mapping, interaction design, prototyping, usability tests, and production.
• Own the full life cycle of AI-native design projects, from design strategy through to execution and launch.
• Design for AI uncertainty and failure with checks and balances to mitigate potential incorrect or fabricated output, incomplete information, refusals, streaming and latency, tool errors, and non-deterministic behaviour.
• Design intuitive experiences for AI agents, copilots, multi-agent systems, dashboards and conversational interfaces, and AI workflows across interaction patterns (memory, citations, long-running actions, etc.)
• Make AI capabilities and their limits legible, so users can calibrate their trust based on expected performance.
• Partner with Product, Engineering and Science teams to align AI experiences to their product designs across all layers: prompt and system design, tone of voice, output structure, content standards, and guardrails.
• Contribute to evaluation: define what good output looks like from the user’s point of view, and help build the rubrics, test sets, and human review loops that measure it.
• Ground designs in common sense, intuition, quantitative and qualitative data: UX research, market research, behavioural and telemetry data, and stakeholder feedback.
• Define success metrics with Product, Science and Engineering— adoption, task success, time-to-value, correction and abandonment rates, trust calibration — and instrument designs so those metrics can be read.

Design systems, best practices and outcomes

• Establish and govern scalable design systems across web, mobile, conversational, voice, and workflows.
• Design interfaces and interaction flows in Figma, other prototyping tools, and AI tooling for rapid idea generation; treat working prototypes as the primary way you align stakeholders.
• Develop and maintain clear design specifications, and hold all stakeholders to the set design quality bar
• Ensure products support English and Arabic, with right-to-left layout, bilingual typography and cultural context
• Design in line with sovereign and responsible-AI expectations: AI disclosure, privacy and data-residency constraints, auditability, and human-in-the-loop control.

Leadership and influence

• Operate as a hands-on leader: set direction while still solving the hardest design problems yourself.
• Recruit, mentor, and lead product designers, both full-time and contractors, while establishing strong standards for craft, critique, and product thinking.
• Present design work to Product, Engineering, Science teams, Inception42 leadership, government stakeholders, enterprise customers, and external partners — you are able to act upon and use their high level feedback well.
• Present complex, creative ideas in a way that is understandable to executives, engineers, and domain experts.

Qualifications:

• An online portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product ownership, interaction design, visual craft, and measurable outcomes. Case studies should show your process and your decisions, not only final screens.
• Experience with best practices for user interface design, information architecture, and interaction design.
• Experience with life-cycle design projects, from design strategy through to execution.

• Strong expertise in user research, information architecture, prototyping, usability testing, and design systems.

Preferred qualifications
