• Experience designing bilingual Arabic and English products; Arabic language ability is a plus but not required

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

jobs.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description
The Enterprise Service Management Centre of Excellence, operating under IT@IFS, is seeking a proactive, analytical and service-minded individual to join our team as a Business Systems Analyst.

The Business Systems Analyst for the ESM CoE is responsible for supporting, analysing and improving a range of enterprise applications used across IFS. The role will work across supported applications within the ESM CoE remit, helping to ensure services remain stable, well-governed and aligned to business needs.

This role sits at the intersection of business engagement, application support, service management and continuous improvement. The Business Systems Analyst will own incidents, requests, problems, changes and demand-related analysis, while also translating business needs into clear requirements, supporting releases and contributing to service transition activities.

Together with global business process owners, platform specialists, engineers, administrators and vendors, we develop multidisciplinary and customer-driven solutions that support scalable, agile and reliable enterprise services for the future.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as Application and Process Subject Matter Expert: Build a strong understanding of assigned supported applications, associated business processes, integrations, service dependencies and operational support models.
• Support Analysis Across Applications: Triage and progress incidents, service requests, problems and changes, ensuring issues are understood, documented, prioritised and moved towards sustainable resolution.
• Translate Business Needs into Clear Requirements: Work with stakeholders to capture business requirements, define acceptance criteria, map process impacts and translate needs into clear functional specifications, user stories or support documentation.
• Support Demand and Change Enablement: Contribute to demand assessment, impact analysis, prioritisation input, change readiness and handover activities where new or changed services require ESM CoE involvement.
• Coordinate with Stakeholders and Vendors: Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, vendors, internal IT teams, platform owners and end users to ensure issues, requirements and decisions are clearly communicated.
• Support Releases, Testing and Service Transition: Review release notes, assess impact, coordinate testing scenarios, support UAT, validate outcomes and ensure operational readiness before changes are transitioned into support.
• Maintain Knowledge and Documentation: Create and maintain knowledge articles, process maps, troubleshooting guides, requirement artefacts and operational documentation to enable consistent support and auditability.
• Improve Service Quality and Ways of Working: Identify inefficiencies, recurring issues, gaps in process or tooling, and recommend practical improvements that align with ITIL practices and business value.
• Use Reporting and Data to Drive Insight: Support the creation and interpretation of service management reporting, backlog analysis, trend reviews and operational dashboards to inform decisions and priorities.
• Demonstrate a Growth Mindset: Actively seek feedback, build cross-application knowledge, remain curious about new technology and show initiative in developing professional and technical capability.

Required Competence

A Business Systems Analyst in the ESM CoE would be expected to demonstrate capability across the following areas:

• Business Analysis: Able to elicit, analyse and document requirements, process flows, impact assessments and practical solution options.
• Service Management: Understands incident, request, problem, change and demand processes, with an appreciation of ITIL-aligned ways of working.
• Application Support and Ownership: Comfortable supporting multiple enterprise applications, understanding dependencies, diagnosing issues and coordinating resolution.
• Stakeholder Communication: Clearly communicates with technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting language to the audience and maintaining a professional service focus.
• Problem Solving: Capable of analysing complex issues, identifying root causes, evaluating options and recommending sustainable solutions.
• Reporting and Insight: Able to interpret operational data, identify trends and present meaningful insight to support prioritisation and service improvement.
• Team Collaboration: Works effectively within a distributed global team, supporting shared goals and contributing to team knowledge sharing.
• Adaptability: Responds well to changing priorities, ambiguous requirements and evolving application landscapes.

Qualifications
Essential

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Computer Science, Operations Management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience in business analysis, application support, service management or product/platform operations within a complex business environment.
• Experience working with enterprise applications, ITSM platforms or business systems used by global teams.
• Ability to capture requirements, document processes, define acceptance criteria and support testing or UAT activities.
• Understanding of ITIL-aligned processes such as incident, request, problem, change and knowledge management.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear actions and documentation.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including stakeholder management and cross-team coordination.
• Ability to work in a distributed global team set-up, with flexibility to collaborate across time zones where required.

Desirable

• ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management certification.
• Experience with ITSM/ESM, finance tools or similar enterprise applications.
• Experience supporting integrations, APIs, data flows or application dependencies between enterprise systems.
• Experience with Agile delivery, backlog management, demand management or service transition activities.
• Experience producing knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, dashboard inputs, service reports or operational communications.
• Awareness of vendor management, support escalation processes and release impact assessment.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Pulse Nova is seeking an experienced Systems Integration Engineering Team Lead to lead the end-to-end integration of radar, electronic warfare (EW), command and control (C2), and multi-sensor systems across naval, ground, and airborne/UAS platforms. The role combines systems architecture, interface management, and multidisciplinary engineering leadership to ensure seamless interoperability, RF coexistence, and reliable system performance. The successful candidate will drive integration planning, verification and validation activities, and system-level troubleshooting while coordinating cross-functional teams.

RESPONSIBILITIES


● Lead the definition of the end-to-end integration architecture combining the NEMUS radar suite, electronic warfare (EW) systems, C2, and additional sensors across naval, ground vehicle, and airborne/UAS platforms.

● Define and maintain system-level requirements, functional architecture, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and technical baselines for each platform variant.

● Analyze and resolve system-level coexistence issues between radar and EW subsystems (RF spectrum overlap, EMI/EMC, antenna placement, shared power and cooling).

● Define and manage interfaces between the radar, EW suite, C2, and other onboard sensors (EO/IR, direction-finding, navigation, IFF, AIS, etc.).

● Lead multidisciplinary integration activities across RF, network/software, C2, and electromechanical disciplines, ensuring correct end-to-end system operation.

● Own the integration plan and schedule, coordinating the RF, network/software, C2, and electromechanical engineers and the installation technicians.

● Define system verification and validation plans, acceptance criteria, and verification matrices; lead FAT, SAT, qualification campaigns, demonstrations, and field trials on naval, ground, and airborne platforms.

● Lead system-level troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, coordinating the multidisciplinary team to resolve technical issues.

● Represent engineering in technical reviews, customer meetings, demonstrations, and deployment activities.

● Prepare and maintain engineering documentation, including requirements, architecture, ICDs, verification matrices, test plans, test reports, and technical assessments.

● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Systems, Electrical, or Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.

● Strong understanding of radar and EW subsystem architecture and of RF coexistence between co-located sensors and effectors.

● Experience integrating multi-sensor systems onto naval, ground-vehicle, or airborne/UAS platforms.

● Experience with C2/C4ISR system integration; familiarity with C2 or comparable defense C2 systems is a strong plus.

● Proven experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and driving issues to resolution.

● Experience with requirements engineering, interface management, and system-level integration testing.

● Experience with verification, validation, qualification, FAT/SAT, and performance assessment activities.

• Share troubleshooting methods, review implementation changes, and mentor engineers. Track availability, incident restoration, recurrence, remediation, and delivery outcomes.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

• 6+ years of enterprise networking or network-security experience, including hands-on responsibility for complex production operations and incident resolution.

• Strong hands-on experience with Aruba switching and wireless, Cisco Catalyst/Nexus routing and switching, and Palo Alto firewalls, including routing protocols, segmentation, policy, NAT, VPN, and high availability.

• Practical experience operating Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, SASE and Zero Trust access controls, proxy forwarding, PAC files, inspection, and exception handling.

• Experience with Azure networking and hybrid connectivity, including VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, routing, UDRs/BGP, NSGs, and network segregation.

• Strong TCP/IP, DNS/DHCP, network access control, and troubleshooting fundamentals; ability to diagnose issues across network, firewall, proxy, cloud, and identity boundaries.

• Experience with monitoring and SIEM integration, secure configurations, vulnerability remediation, incident and problem management, controlled changes, and vendor SLA escalations.

• Clear technical communication, sound operational judgment, disciplined documentation, and the ability to coordinate changes and incidents across technical teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Cisco ISE/802.1X, Catalyst Center, or Catalyst SD-WAN where deployed.

• Relevant Cisco CCNP, Aruba, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Azure networking, or ITIL certification, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

Owns the design and code quality of one or more components, actively educating and guiding junior engineers while beginning to take on true leadership responsibility - stepping in for the team lead/manager when they're unavailable, and starting to practice delegation across specific technical scopes or sub-groups within the team.

Contributes to elevating the overall Sysco engineering ecosystem through active participation in Communities of Practice, technical workshops, knowledge-sharing initiatives, and technical publications.

Some flexibility in daily schedule may be expected, on an as-needed basis, to allow for reasonable working-hour overlap with global colleagues, supporting collaboration across regions including North America and Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Delivery & Architecture

• Own design and code quality for one or more components; guide juniors on best practices, secure programming, data privacy, and AI-assisted code standards - raising concerns when AI output introduces risk.

• Apply concurrency/parallel programming concepts and multiple programming paradigms in line with product requirements; take accountability for prioritizing vulnerability fixes within owned components.

• Apply design patterns and reference architectures proficiently, educating juniors on the same; flag deviations from enterprise-defined patterns to seniors, and use incrementally built business-domain expertise to support team leadership's technical decision-making.

• Evaluate frameworks, libraries, and AI tools, making recommendations to the team; review AI tool evaluations to inform leadership decisions and ensure alignment with company guidelines.

Delivery, Quality & Operations

• Guide juniors on release management processes and lifecycles; apply the team's chosen project methodology proficiently, with working knowledge of others, and evaluate/introduce AI-assisted process improvements.

• Uphold code quality and process adherence standards, leading onboarding of team members to these standards - including ensuring AI-generated code meets the same defect and coverage bar as human-written work.

• Independently monitor applications, resolve complex issues without supervision, and build dashboards/monitors on approved tooling, while educating juniors on the same.

• Contribute to cloud platform design work and educate juniors on DevOps concepts, tools, and cloud AI service usage in line with DevSecOps and security guidelines.

People & Stakeholder Management

• Step in for the team lead/manager when absent, guiding the team toward its goals and handling stakeholder correspondence professionally.

• Take ownership of specific technical scopes or sub-groups of junior engineers, practicing delegation rather than carrying every task personally.

• Adapt communication style and technical depth to different audiences when presenting results or running demonstrations.

• Encourage juniors to think creatively and experiment with new approaches and AI tools within company guidelines; socialize industry and AI trends and innovation ideas with the team and leads.

• Actively contribute to technical interviews and hiring decisions for the team, evaluating both technical depth and team fit to build a strong, well-rounded engineering team.

Requirements

Technical Skills

• Strong command of design patterns, reference architectures, and secure/data-privacy-aware coding practices, including in AI-assisted contexts.

• Practical experience with concurrency, parallel programming, and multiple programming paradigms.

• Working knowledge of cloud platform design and core DevOps/DevSecOps concepts.

• Ability to evaluate frameworks, tools, and AI-assisted development output for quality, security, and business fit.

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Demonstrated readiness to lead a team in a manager's absence, with sound judgment on delegation.

• Strong stakeholder communication, adaptable to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Proven mentorship ability, particularly in guiding juniors' technical growth and AI tool adoption.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The AI Transformation Manager leads the refinery AI transformation agenda by identifying, prioritizing, orchestrating, and embedding AI and data-driven initiatives that deliver measurable business value. The role acts as the bridge between business functions and technical teams, ensuring that AI opportunities are converted into practical, scalable, and value-generating solutions. The position drives the transformation pipeline across operations, maintenance, engineering, reliability, planning, energy, supply chain, Inspection and support functions by maintaining a robust use case portfolio, aligning stakeholders, enforcing delivery governance, and supporting adoption and scale-up.

Key Accountabilities

A. AI Transformation Strategy & Roadmap

• Lead the refinery AI transformation agenda in alignment with business priorities and enterprise digital strategy.
• Translate strategic objectives into a structured AI transformation roadmap and prioritized portfolio.
• Identify high-value opportunities for AI, analytics, automation, and intelligent decision support across refinery functions.
• Support the transition from isolated pilots into scalable deployments with repeatable value delivery.

B. Use Case Identification & Prioritization

• Engage business stakeholders to identify pain points, opportunities, and transformation themes suitable for AI deployment.
• Evaluate opportunities using value, feasibility, data readiness, implementation effort, and risk criteria.
• Develop concept notes, business cases, initiative charters, KPIs, and expected-benefit logic for shortlisted opportunities.

C. Cross-Functional Delivery Leadership

• Orchestrate end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives in coordination with operations, maintenance, engineering, Digital teams.
• Track milestones, manage interdependencies, remove barriers, and escalate issues when required.
• Ensure initiatives progress through idea assessment, design, pilot, deployment, adoption, and scale-up.

D. Value Delivery & Performance Management

• Define expected business outcomes and benefit-realization logic for each initiative.
• Monitor progress against value targets such as throughput, yield, energy, reliability, maintenance cost avoidance, HSE improvement, labor productivity, or margin uplift.
• Provide clear leadership reporting on initiative health, delivered value, forecast value, and implementation status.

E. Change Management & Adoption

• Drive stakeholder readiness and business alignment for AI-enabled changes in workflows, decisions, and operating models.
• Coordinate communication, awareness, training, and adoption actions required for sustained use.
• Help embed AI solutions into day-to-day operating and management routines rather than leaving them as stand-alone tools.

F. Governance, Standards & Risk Management

• Apply required AI governance, risk, compliance, and control processes for AI initiatives.
• Coordinate with cybersecurity, data governance, architecture, legal, procurement, and HSE stakeholders as needed.
• Support responsible, safe, and business-aligned use of AI in refinery environments.

G. External Collaboration & Vendor Management

• Support development of scopes of work, technical and business requirements, proposal evaluation, and vendor delivery monitoring.
• Ensure external partners remain aligned with refinery needs, data constraints, operational realities, and value expectations.

Role Interfaces and Delivery Context

Internal Interfaces

• Refinery operations; maintenance and reliability; process engineering / technical services; planning and economics; energy management; HSE; IT / OT / cybersecurity; finance; procurement; and leadership forums.

External Interfaces

• Refinery operations; maintenance and reliability; process engineering / technical services; planning and economics; energy management; HSE; IT / OT / cybersecurity; finance; procurement; and leadership forums.

Typical Initiative Themes

• Process optimization, AI-enabled decision support, predictive analytics, operator assistance, energy optimization, inspection / robotics, anomaly detection, and value-tracking programs

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Preferred background in chemical, process, instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or industrial engineering.
• Master’s degree, transformation certification, project-management certification, or AI / analytics certification is advantageous.

Experience Requirements

• Typically 8–12 years of relevant experience in refinery, oil and gas, petrochemicals, energy, or industrial transformation environments.
• Demonstrated experience in digital transformation, AI or analytics use case delivery, operations improvement, or technology implementation in industrial settings.
• Strong experience in stakeholder engagement, business case development, cross-functional coordination, and value realization tracking.

Technical Knowledge

• Working knowledge of refinery operations, value levers, and performance drivers.
• Understanding of AI, analytics, machine learning, and industrial digital use cases from ideation through scale-up.
• Awareness of business case methods, benefit tracking, change management, data governance, and OT / IT deployment considerations.
• Familiarity with historians, APC, ERP, CMMS, planning tools, and performance reporting systems is preferred.

ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


The Senior Programme Quality Engineer in HALCON is responsible for planning, coordinating, and assuring quality activities throughout the Programme lifecycle, ensuring that products, processes, and activities comply with applicable standards, customer, contractual, regulatory, and company requirements.

Acting as the designated quality focal point for the assigned Programme or scope, the Senior PQE provides independent quality oversight, supports Programme governance and decision-making, manages and communicates quality risks and non-conformances, promotes continual improvement, and coordinates quality activities across Programme Management, Engineering, Design for Advanced Manufacturing (DFAM), Manufacturing, Configuration Management, other Quality functions, and relevant interfacing functions.

The Senior PQE ensures that quality requirements are effectively embedded and verified across design, development, verification, validation, qualification, production, and acceptance activities, supporting the timely delivery of conforming products.

RESPONSIBILITIES


Key Responsibilities

• Lead programme quality activities and act as the main point of contact for quality, audits, reporting, and customer quality matters.

• Oversee quality throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with company, customer, regulatory, and industry standards.

• Develop and maintain Quality Assurance and Quality Control Plans, supporting inspections, testing, product release, and production readiness.

• Review designs, technical documentation, test results, and deliverables to ensure quality, traceability, and compliance.

• Manage non-conformances, deviations, root cause investigations, and corrective actions to drive continuous improvement.

• Support audits, Stage Gate Reviews, configuration control, and programme quality reporting.

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality requirements during testing, qualification, and other high-risk activities.

• Partner with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, suppliers, and customers to resolve quality issues and improve performance.

• Monitor programme risks, quality metrics, and improvement initiatives, ensuring timely issue resolution.

• Mentor junior quality engineers and promote a strong culture of quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Degree in Aerospace, Aeronautics, Systems, Electrical, Electronics & Mechatronics Engineering

• 8+ years of direct experience in Quality Engineering, Product Design Assurance, or Development Engineering, with demonstrated experience supporting product Design and Development activities within the Space/Aerospace/Satelites/Defence Manufacturing industry.

• A good understanding of System Engineering processes; working knowledge one or more of the following: guided missiles, drones, UAV, space satellites or complex multidisciplinary systems that include subsystems such as warheads/fuzes, seekers, propulsion/motors, avionics, actuators, Printed Circuit Boards (PCB) Assemblies

• Experience with testing tools and software test equipment

jobs.title: Senior Lead / Principal Software Engineer (Agentic Engineering / Research) - IFS Labs
jobs.description:
Job Description
At IFS Labs, we explore what is next for enterprise software and turn emerging technologies into working capabilities that shape future IFS products. Our focus spans applied AI, agentic systems, next-generation application architectures, data services, strategic technology direction, and technology partnerships.

We are looking for a Senior Lead / Principal Software Engineer with strong software engineering and architectural skills, combined with a product mindset and a passion for solving real-world problems through software and AI.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on building software, validating emerging technologies, creating production-grade prototypes, and influencing future product and technology direction across IFS. The emphasis is on delivering working solutions that can move from investigation and prototype into real product capabilities.

We are particularly interested in candidates who embrace modern AI-driven engineering practices and agentic engineering approaches to accelerate research, architecture, software development, testing, and delivery. The successful candidate will be comfortable using AI as a force multiplier—leveraging agentic workflows to automate routine knowledge work, rapidly evaluate technologies, synthesise architectural insights, and significantly shorten the path from idea to working software while maintaining high standards of engineering quality.

Projects typically run for 6–12 months and are delivered individually or in small teams. Work ranges from evaluating emerging technologies and architectural patterns to building capabilities that influence future IFS products, platforms, and technology strategy.

A key part of the role involves creating compelling demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical showcases for major IFS events, customer engagements, and strategic initiatives. This includes building innovative solutions, validating ideas with customers and partners, and communicating technical vision to diverse audiences.

As a Senior Lead / Principal Software Engineer in IFS Labs, you will identify, evaluate, and apply emerging technologies to real customer and industry challenges, transforming ideas into working capabilities that influence future IFS products, platforms, and technology strategy.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, evaluate, and validate emerging technologies, architectural patterns, and industry trends relevant to IFS products and customers.
• Design, build, and deliver prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and production-ready capabilities across software engineering, cloud, data, and AI domains.
• Lead technical investigations and architectural studies, producing clear recommendations, reference implementations, and actionable next steps.
• Drive complex technical initiatives from concept through implementation and product handover, applying agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate delivery.
• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Industry teams, Engineering teams, Sales, Presales, customers, and partners to validate ideas, solve real business problems, and shape future IFS products and technology direction.
• Contribute to technical strategy, architectural direction, and engineering practices across IFS.
• Represent IFS in customer engagements, strategic demonstrations, major events, and partner collaborations.
• Mentor engineers and champion engineering excellence, technical curiosity, and high-quality delivery.

Qualifications
Essential

• Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering and software architecture, demonstrated through successfully delivered products and platforms.
• Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, C#, Golang, or TypeScript.
• Extensive experience designing, building, deploying, and operating enterprise-grade software, with strong architectural expertise across distributed, cloud-native, API-driven, and event-driven systems.
• Proven track record of taking ideas from concept and prototype through to production-ready solutions that integrate with enterprise applications, business processes, and data platforms.
• Demonstrated proficiency in AI-assisted research and software engineering, using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, and modern AI platforms to accelerate technology evaluation, architectural reasoning, and implementation.
• Exceptional ability to rapidly learn and apply new technologies, combined with strong systems thinking, architectural judgement, and a bias towards experimentation and delivery.
• Strong engineering judgement with a relentless focus on code quality, maintainability, security, operational reliability, and fitness for purpose.
• Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence technical direction, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Ability to connect technology decisions to customer outcomes, business value, and product strategy, combining innovative thinking with pragmatic execution.

Desirable

• Experience with applied AI, agentic systems, LLM-powered applications, or data-intensive platforms.
• Experience applying agentic engineering practices and agentic workflows to accelerate research, architecture, implementation, testing, and documentation.
• Experience with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) or comparable agent-driven engineering methodologies such as BMAD.
• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, including CI/CD, containerization, observability, and infrastructure automation.
• Strong full-stack engineering experience across modern backend technologies.
• Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, and domain experts to validate ideas and deliver business value.
• Experience with enterprise or industrial domains such as ERP, Service Management, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, industrial IoT, robotics, autonomous systems, digital twins, or cyber-physical systems.
• Knowledge of the IFS product portfolio and the industries it serves.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Build service management practices that people understand, use and improve. You will turn the ITSM roadmap into working processes, reliable service data and practical digital workflows that help Inception42 deliver consistent services to colleagues and customers.

This is a hands-on practice leadership role: you will guide implementation across teams, coach process practitioners and take responsibility for adoption and measurable improvement within your assigned remit.

Works closely with service owners, Change and Release, Application Support, Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Information Security and ITSM platform specialists.

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

• Lead the design and rollout of prioritised incident, request, problem, knowledge and service level practices, with clear roles, escalation paths and usable procedures.

• Translate maturity assessments and service feedback into a sequenced improvement backlog. Pilot changes, incorporate feedback and establish ownership before expanding adoption.

• Develop service performance reporting with trustworthy definitions and data. Investigate missed commitments and help service owners agree practical improvements.

• Improve knowledge quality, self-service journeys and request automation. Measure successful fulfilment and user effort as well as adoption.

• Establish proportionate service, asset and configuration data requirements, working with accountable owners to keep critical records accurate and useful.

• Coach colleagues, run working sessions and maintain practice guidance. Address process friction and inconsistent adoption directly with the teams involved.

• Coordinate delivery across contributors and suppliers, escalating priority conflicts and risks to the Senior Manager with clear recommendations.

• Within six months, establish practice owners, baselines, workflows, and an improvement plan; implement initial platform improvements with trained teams and evidenced adoption; and track service review actions to completion.

• Within twelve months, demonstrate consistent use, measurable improvement in fulfilment, recurring issues, knowledge use or service performance, and practitioners who sustain the practices with clear guidance and coaching.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• Substantial practical ITSM experience, including leading the implementation or improvement of several service management practices across multiple teams.

• Evidence of taking a process from design into sustained daily use, with measurable improvements in service quality, speed or user experience.

• Strong applied ITIL knowledge and sound judgement about the level of governance appropriate to different services and risks.

• Hands-on experience translating processes into an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management or ManageEngine, including workflows, testing and reporting.

• Ability to analyse service data, challenge data quality and turn findings into clear priorities and accountable actions.

• Confident facilitation, stakeholder communication and coaching skills; able to lead delivery through influence and follow through on commitments.

Nice to Have

• Experience in a software or digital product company and familiarity with Agile delivery and engineering support workflows.

• Relevant ITIL practice qualifications or ITSM platform certification, supported by implementation experience.

• Experience with service catalogue design, configuration data, cross-functional workflows or service automation.

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for an experienced **Security Engineer** to help design, implement, and operate security across our infrastructure, applications, networks, and isolated computing environments. This is a hands-on technical role covering identity and access management, cryptography, secrets management, endpoint security, secure software delivery, and on-premises infrastructure. You'll work across connected environments, client-site data centres, and air-gapped systems where security, reliability, and operational discipline are essential. jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work with some of the region's largest and most influential organisations
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work with some of the region's largest and most influential organisations in Financial Services, Retail, Travel & Hospitality, and Media. These are enterprises with complex technology estates, demanding regulatory and operational requirements, and big ambitions for what the cloud and AI can unlock next.

This is a role for a trusted technical advisor. You will earn a seat at the table with senior business and technology leaders and understand the business priorities behind their technology decisions. You will design architectures that help them scale, modernise, and innovate. That could mean migrating and modernising mission-critical workloads, building enterprise-grade data and analytics platforms, or moving generative AI and machine learning from proof of concept to production at scale. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and AI/ML.

You will partner with customers to shape their cloud strategy around business outcomes: speeding up time-to-market, unlocking new revenue streams, improving operational efficiency and resilience, and building the digital foundation for long-term transformation. You will earn trust by showing technical credibility, working through complexity across large organisations, and delivering results that move the business forward.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with enterprise customers end-to-end. This means:

- Engaging customers to understand their business drivers for cloud adoption, assess their existing on-premises or multi-cloud landscape, and architect a credible path to AWS

- Building the technical case for AWS: total cost of ownership analyses, migration strategies, and proof-of-value engagements that deliver value.

- Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, migration runbooks, landing zone blueprints, and production-ready reference architectures. You lead by doing, not just advising.

- Helping customers envision and build with generative AI and machine learning — often as the catalyst that makes AWS the platform of choice by demonstrating what's uniquely possible with AWS AI/ML services.

- Partnering closely with Account Managers and Business Development to shape the go-to-market strategy for accounts — you are the technical credibility that converts pipeline into adoption.

- Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights from customers into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

- Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, immersion days, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

- You make the team stronger by mentoring fellow Solutions Architects — sharing what you know and helping others grow.

A day in the life

No two days look the same. You might spend the morning in a technical workshop with a financial services customer exploring whether to lift-and-shift their core banking platform or re-architect on AWS, then pivot to a hands-on proof of concept helping a retail customer build on Amazon Bedrock. In the afternoon you might build a landing zone design for a customer that just signed their Enterprise Agreement, draft a migration playbook for a hospitality company, or join a call with an AWS service team to advocate for a feature that would unblock a key deal. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and the patience required to build trust with the urgency of a team that moves fast.

About the team

AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Basic qualifications
- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications
- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS

- Experience demonstrating technical breadth in AWS and/or cloud fundamentals

- - Experience designing landing zones, multi-account strategies, and governance frameworks for new adopters

- - Experience working with end-user or developer communities

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


ADVANCED CONCEPTS is an entity within EDGE dedicated to the design and deployment of advanced, innovative technologies. ADVANCED CONCEPTS is fast-tracking the development of high-technology autonomous systems, including three Medium Endurance, High Altitude, fixed-wing unmanned aerial systems, a family of precision loitering munitions, a cost- effective family of cruise missiles, and a range of guided artillery munitions.

CNC Programmer requires to independently program and operate CNC mills, lathes and multi-axis machines using Mastercam 2022 and PowerMill Ultimate to manufacture precision components.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Independently program, set up, operate CNC machines (mills, lathes, or multi-axis).

• Interpret complex engineering drawings and convert them into CNC programs using

• CAM PACKAGE - MASTERCAM 2022 and PowerMill Ultimate.

• Select appropriate tooling, fixtures, and machining strategies for precision components.

• Optimize machining parameters to improve efficiency, tool life, and part quality.

• Perform first-piece inspection and troubleshoot machining issues.

• Train and guide junior technicians on machine operation and safety practices.

• Ensure routine maintenance and upkeep of CNC equipment and workstations.

• Support loading and machine setup as necessary

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Diploma or Degree Mechanical Engineering / CNC Machining
• Experience with multi-axis CNC machines, mill-turn centers.
• Familiarity with prototyping or low-volume production workflows.
• Must possess a strong command of the English language and written communication skills.
• Strong initiative to perform cleaning and support activities
• Good troubleshooting, communication, and mentoring abilities.
• Can-do attitude and proactive nature
• Commitment and strong sense of accountability
• Organization and diligence in reporting work activities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Proficient in reading engineering drawings, GD&T,

• Strong understanding of cutting tools, materials, speeds, and feeds.

• Able to independently produce high-precision parts with minimal supervision.

• Skilled in creating, editing, and optimizing CNC programs (G-code, M-code) for multi-axis machining operations.

• Process Optimization – Ability to fine-tune machining parameters to improve cycle time, tool life, and overall efficiency

• Verify dimensions, clearances, and alignments using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other measuring tools.

• Ensure finished parts meet company quality standards, ISO procedures, and customer requirements.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.description:
Overview:


Abu Dhabi

Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception42 functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception42 is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inceptionai.ai

Overview

Inception is seeking a highly proficient and accomplished Applied Scientist, with a proven track record, to develop efficient deep-learning and generative AI algorithms and conceive innovative AI-centric models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with our product development teams, applying emerging technologies across a diverse range of applications

Responsibilities:


What You’ll Own

In the Applied Scientist role you will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. Your work will involve the creation and optimization of cutting-edge AI algorithms and deep learning models, contributing to advancements in areas such as semantic understanding, multidimensional data interpretation, and human-machine interactions. Furthermore, your innovative efforts will be applied to a spectrum of practical use cases, serving pivotal industries such as finance, oil and gas, environmental science, and healthcare, thereby driving forward the frontier of impactful AI solutions in real-world scenarios.

• Engage in the design, analysis and optimization of foundational and applied research to power the state-of-the-art AI algorithms and model capabilities at Inception. This will involve staying well-informed of emerging trends, understanding and manipulating complex datasets, and conceptualizing models that are both innovative and applicable to real-world scenarios.

• Work on comprehensive solutions that integrate various modalities, including text, audio, and visual data, enhancing the AI's ability to understand and interpret human interaction in a more nuanced manner.

• Collaborate with researchers and engineers across teams at Inception for the design, development, and continual improvement of AI algorithms, ensuring the implementations of such algorithms are optimized for efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

• Work alongside product development teams to integrate new algorithms and models into broader product offerings, and conduct proofs of concept (POC) as per client needs, ensuring that these innovations translate into tangible benefits for users and stakeholders.

• Propose scenarios where AI techniques could improve the efficiency of the customer’s business.

• Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

The criteria for your success would include cost savings achieved, number of use cases investigated & datasets mined, number of innovations/POCs deployed, number of existing processes optimized, and customer NPS.

To qualify, you must have

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.

• Minimum 6 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities

• Track record of conducting high-level research, preferably evidenced by publications in peer-reviewed journals or a history of product-driven research and development.

Ideally, you’ll also need

• A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving

• In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning

• Excellent communication skills

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: 3rd Party Developer Hub Manager

Shape the future of our distribution hub with your expertise in project governance and stakeholder management.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Lead third-party development within ADNOC Distribution’s Mobility Hub strategy by originating, structuring, and coordinating investor/developer projects from concept to handover. Act as the single point of contact for external developers and investors, managing the commercial, technical, contractual, and governance requirements needed to integrate sites seamlessly into the Hub ecosystem. Ensure timely approvals, risk-controlled delivery, and operational readiness that strengthen customer experience and portfolio returns.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Job Specific Accountabilities

Partnership Origination & Commercial Structuring

• Identify and qualify 3P development opportunities aligned to hub typologies, network priorities, and investment criteria.
• Prepare and refine commercial models, heads of terms, and term-sheet options to balance value creation, risk allocation, and compliance.
• Coordinate internal inputs (Finance, Legal, BD) to validate business cases, sensitivity scenarios, and approval requirements.
• Support investor due diligence (technical, commercial, regulatory), addressing queries and aligning key assumptions.
• Draft and socialize decision packs for governance forums, ensuring clear options, risks, and recommendations.

Contract Lifecycle & Risk Management

• Lead the end-to-end contract process—from RFI/RFP support and bid clarifications to negotiation of definitive agreements.
• Ensure clarity on roles, deliverables, milestones, warranties, performance securities, and exit/step-in provisions.
• Track contractual obligations and conditions precedent (CPs), coordinating timely closure with internal and external parties.
• Maintain a live risk register covering commercial, schedule, technical, HSE, and authority risks, with mitigation plans.
• Manage variations and change control, preserving scope, economics, and governance integrity.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Technical Alignment

• Align site layout, access, utilities, and design standards with Engineering Projects, Operations, HSE, and Property Services.
• Coordinate authority requirements (utility providers, municipality, civil defense, etc.) to de-risk approvals on the critical path.
• Ensure 3P specifications support hub customer experience (wayfinding, parking circulation, tenant adjacencies, brand touchpoints).
• Validate readiness criteria for construction start (permits, insurances, method statements, interfaces).
• Facilitate technical reviews and close-out of comments to keep design and procurement on schedule.

Delivery Governance & Operational Readiness

• Run a stage-based governance cadence (business case, design freeze, pre-award, start-up, pre-opening) with documented gate criteria.
• Track execution milestones, critical path, and dependencies; escalate slippage early and propose recovery actions.
• Coordinate with Operations and HSE on commissioning, OR checklists, training/handovers, and defects management.
• Validate as-built documentation, warranties, and O&M manuals prior to handover into steady-state operations.
• Capture lessons learned and feed improvements into playbooks and templates.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

• Serve as the single point of contact for developers/investors, providing clear updates, action logs, and decisions required.
• Prepare concise progress reports, dashboards, and risk summaries for EMT/ELT and relevant committees.
• Coordinate with Marketing/Brand on key milestones and external communications where applicable.
• Ensure records are audit-ready (approvals, contracts, CP closures, change logs, correspondence).
• Maintain confidentiality and adherence to governance, delegation of authority (DoA), and information security standards.

Portfolio Performance & Optimization

• Monitor post-launch performance (throughput, uptime, commercial KPIs) and identify improvement opportunities with partners.
• Recommend re-scoping or enhancement measures (amenity mix, access improvements, utilities optimization) to maximize returns.
• Track contractual performance measures (SLAs, liquidated damages where applicable) and manage under-performance remedies.
• Support periodic portfolio reviews and rebalancing of pipeline priorities based on performance and market dynamics.
• Contribute to strategy refreshes, investment theses, and international roll-out playbooks as required.

Continuous Improvement & Tools

• Maintain and enhance standard templates (term sheets, risk registers, gate checklists, CP trackers, and reporting packs).
• Promote use of digital tools for document control, schedule tracking, and stakeholder collaboration.
• Benchmark external practices to refine commercial structures and execution standards.
• Propose process simplifications that reduce cycle time without compromising assurance.
• Support training and knowledge-sharing sessions across the Franchise & Property Services Division.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Real Estate, or a related field.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

• 8 years of relevant experience in commercial real‑estate development, PPP/3P projects, or mobility/retail infrastructure.
• Hands‑on experience in commercial modelling, contract negotiation, and approvals (CPs, permits, utilities).
• Strong exposure to design coordination and delivery governance (stage‑gates, risk, change control).
• Proven ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders and counterparties to deadlines.
• Commercial acumen (term sheets, risk allocation, value drivers)
• Contracting & negotiation; change/claims awareness
• Technical literacy (layouts, utilities, basic MEP/HSE considerations)
• Project governance, planning, and risk management
• Executive‑level communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence
• Strong documentation, decision‑pack preparation, and audit‑readiness
• Proficiency with MS Office and project/collaboration tools (e.g., MS Project, SharePoint/Teams, Asana/Jira)

jobs.title: Data Center Infra Engineer  - 2027 Internship
jobs.summary: Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary
jobs.description:
Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us!

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

- Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region

- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures

- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support

- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered

- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday to Thursday.

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life

0

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In the last year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or another equivalent technical discipline, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date

- Knowledge of Power Systems, Fluid Dynamics, and/or Thermodynamics

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems

- Coursework in commercial or industrial power systems and/or mechanical systems

- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: AWS Solutions Architect - Kuwait Nationals
jobs.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that will have an opportunity to work with customers, account managers and several internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and help accelerate the adoption of AWS. In collaboration with sales, you will drive AWS platform adoption across a broad set of customers. 



As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. The ability to link technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.



For the Solutions Architect role, we are looking for a candidate who is comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. He or she will be broadly competent across many areas of technology and deep in a handful of areas. It's ok for them to be less deep in some places, but we need to feel confident that they have the fundamentals and the ability to learn complex new technologies quickly. 



On the business side, we are looking for excellent communication skills. The Solutions Architect will spend most of their day interacting with customers via email, phone, instant messaging, and in-person meetings. They will meet with developers, team leads, engineering directors, and CxOs. Given the large portion of customers who are self-served, interest in and ability to create one-to-many content such as reference architectures and blog posts is an important part of the role.



On the soft-skills side, we are looking for ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience and solid ability to pick up on non-verbal communication. Also ability to pick up on “un-said” drivers is important.



On the personal attributes side, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about technology and have the drive and capability to absorb and retain vast amounts of deep technical information continuously.





Job responsibilities

• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform

• Partner with the account management team, formulate and execute an account strategy.

• Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud

• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS

• Capture and share best-practice knowledge within the AWS solutions architect community

• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers

• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates

• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

We are hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in western Saudi Arabia, based in Jeddah. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS’s growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of high-profile enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas.

Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address complex business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also play a key role in competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS.

You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and deep in at least 2–3 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers’ successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including CxOs, VPs, Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers.

Key job responsibilities

• In partnership with Account Managers and Business Development, drive long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions.

• Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Jeddah and western Saudi Arabia region, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing their long-term technology strategy.

• Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and lead deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS.

• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (e.g., Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays).

• Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures.

• Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support — gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and mentoring fellow Solutions Architects in the region.

A day in the life

As a Senior Solutions Architect in Jeddah, your day revolves around customer impact. You might start the morning preparing an architecture proposal for an enterprise customer exploring a migration from on-premises or competing cloud platforms to AWS. Mid-morning, you join a deep-dive technical session with a customer’s engineering team, whiteboarding a microservices architecture for their digital platform and advising on the right mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services.

After lunch, you collaborate with your Account Manager and the wider account team on a strategy call — aligning on the technical win plan for a competitive opportunity and identifying the right Specialist SAs or ProServe resources to bring in. Later in the afternoon, you might lead a workshop or Immersion Day for a group of developers at a customer site, walking them through hands-on labs on Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernisation with EKS.

Between customer meetings, you capture feedback on product gaps, draft a blog post on a solution pattern you designed last week, or review an architecture created by a teammate. Your week also includes internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, community knowledge-sharing sessions, and preparation for upcoming events. No two days are the same, but the constant is clear: you are the customer’s trusted technical partner, and your work directly drives their success on AWS

Basic qualifications
- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

- Knowledge of cloud architecture

Preferred qualifications
- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience in a technical role within a sales organization

- Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers

- Experience designing or advising on AI/ML workloads, including model training, inference, and deployment on cloud infrastructure

- Experience with generative AI concepts and their application to enterprise use cases (e.g., foundation models, RAG architectures, AI agents, prompt engineering)Preferred / Nice-to-have:

- Experience architecting data pipelines and data platforms that support AI/ML workloads (e.g., data lakes, feature stores, vector databases)

- Hands-on experience with AI/ML frameworks and services (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) or equivalent cloud AI platforms
