jobs.title: Security Engineer (DFIR Lab)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Become part of our team as a Security Engineer (DFIR Lab), managing and maintaining the DFIR Lab’s infrastructure and systems. Oversee hardware, software, and documentation, ensuring security and data integrity. Ideal for candidates with significant technical lab experience and expertise in digital forensics and incident response tools.
jobs.description:
Overview:


Manage and maintain the DFIR Lab’s infrastructure, hardware, software, process and documentation.

Responsibilities:


• Maintain and manage the team’s DFIR Lab’s hardware and software systems, ensuring availability and performance for the team engagements
• Keep the team’s DFIR Lab’s asset inventory up to date and contribute to the process of license renewals, purchases and budgeting
• Deploy, configure and maintain forensic and incident response tools like EnCase, Magnet Axiom, FTK, Cellebrite, THOR, Velociraptor, KAPE, IDA Pro, etc.
• Configure and optimize forensics workstations and laptops, war laptops, servers and storage systems
• Ensure the team’s DFIR Lab adheres to security, privacy and data integrity standards
• Implement access controls, logging, audit trails and monitoring solutions to secure the lab environment
• Evaluate and contribute to the testing and recommendation of new tools and technologies to enhance the Lab’s capabilities
• Develop and maintain scripts or automation tools to streamline workflows and improve efficiency
• Contribute to process documentation and continuous service improvement activities
• Create and update SOPs for lab operations
• Document forensic processes, lab configurations and tool usage guidelines
• Collaboration with customers to deploy hardware and software for assessments and incident response engagements
• Execute lab tasks in support of cyber incident response engagements
• Proficiency with Digital Forensics & Incident Response tools (Cellebrite, THOR, Velociraptor, KAPE, IDA Pro, Security Onion, FTK Imager, Magnet Axiom, EnCase and others)
• Good understanding of Incident Response and Digital Forensics tools deployment and functionalities such as EDR, NDR, forensic artifact collectors, intrusion detection, security monitoring, log management
• Experience with digital forensics software and equipment such as write blockers, specialized cables and wires in a technical environment, forensics workstations, forensics laptops, adapters and connectors
• Experience with (or at least knowledge of) evidence management and data acquisition in a lab in terms of supporting incident response and digital forensics
• Good Experience with Linux system structure, commands, functions and tools
• Good Experience with networking devices: switches, routers and firewalls
• Understanding of storage devices such as NAS
• Good Experience with virtualization using VMWare ESXi (Nutanix and other virtualization software knowledge would be a plus)
• Knowledge of building baseline system configurations for servers and workstations
• Good Experience and familiarity with server and desktop operating systems for Windows, Linux/Unix and Mac
• Experience in managing cloud-based environments

Qualifications:


Skills/ Certifications: -

Desired certifications in a minimum of one discipline: Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Cloud Computing, Linux/Windows Administration, Penetration Testing, Security Engineering such as CCE, CHFI, GCFE, INE Security, Microsoft/Azure/VMware/RedHat certification

Minimum Work Experience : -

• 5+ years working in a technical lab, data center, DFIR or System Engineering teams with hands-on experience in setting up scalable technical environments.

Education : -

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or Engineering is desirable, but not mandatory.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Cloud Services
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Engineer - Cloud Services

The Big Picture  

About Sysco LABS: 

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry. 

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion. 

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations. 

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer. 

Role Overview

As a Senior Engineer of Sysco’s Global Public Cloud Engineering Team, you will own and support our multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure and service transformation. You will assist the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, Fastly (CDN/WAF) and Cloud Governance Platforms focusing relentlessly on cloud-native patterns and the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO). Blending hands-on engineering execution with technical leadership, you will set enterprise standards for Infrastructure-as-Code, automated governance, edge security, and developer enablement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Cloud Transformation

• Act as point of contact for multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure services transformation, establishing architecture standards and golden patterns for provisioning and deployment.

• Support cloud-native solutions over legacy lift-and-shift patterns, aligning all designs with the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability).

• Design and implement enterprise cloud architectures, develop cloud landing zones and platform capabilities, design hybrid-cloud and multi-cloud connectivity.

• Define and own end-to-end Solution Architecture (Infrastructure, applications, and data technologies) utilizing service-oriented architecture principles.

• Assist migration initiatives, including On-Premises-to-Cloud and Cloud-to-Cloud migrations with zero downtime architectures and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) validation.

• AI Infrastructure & Workload Support: Support robust, scalable, and secure underlying cloud infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (including GPU-optimized nodes, vector database connectivity, and secure model serving endpoints) across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

• AI-Assisted Engineering Productivity: Help the secure adoption of AI-driven developer tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) within infrastructure teams, establishing safety guardrails for automated code and Infrastructure-as-Code generation.

• ITIL-Aligned Cloud Engineering/Operations: Bridge modern cloud engineering practices with IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks (ITIL v4 or above), ensuring rapid deployment velocity is balanced with robust service quality, predictability, and risk control.

2. Governance, Security & Compliance

• Design and enforce enterprise Cloud Governance strategies, implementing automated guardrails and continuous compliance using Cloud Custodian and native cloud policies (e.g., AWS SCPs, Azure Policies).

• Support comprehensive Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM), tenant isolation, federated authentication, and least-privilege security models.

• Partner with security teams to configure and manage enterprise edge security architectures, integrating Fastly CDN and NFWAF (Next-Gen WAF) to protect core applications from modern web threats.

• Ensure end-to-end security and regulatory compliance across all enterprise infrastructure, data pipelines, and application configurations.

• AI Governance & Policy-as-Code: Extend Cloud Custodian and native cloud governance engines to audit, monitor, and enforce compliance policies on cloud-hosted AI and generative AI services, preventing unauthorized shadow AI deployments.

• AI Security & Data Privacy: Partner with security teams to ensure secure data pipelines, strict API rate-limiting, and egress/ingress protection via Fastly CDN and NFWAF for enterprise AI applications. Implement FinOps guardrails specifically tailored for high-cost AI/ML resource consumption.

3. DevOps, Automation & CI/CD Excellence

• Standardize and govern Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and Terragrunt for modular, DRY multi-cloud deployments.

• Optimization and management of CI/CD pipelines, driving adoption toward GitHub and GitHub Actions while managing legacy Jenkins maintenance.

• Develop advanced automation scripts and custom orchestration tools using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.

• Ability to support configuration management frameworks and server baseline standards using Ansible, alongside containerized runtime workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

4. Technical Leadership & Engineering Support

• Troubleshoot critical production issues, perform root cause analyses, and drive technical problem-solving across cross-functional engineering squads.

• Conducting rigorous code and Pull Request (PR) reviews for Terraform configurations and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and maintain comprehensive internal knowledge bases, technical documentation, and reusable architecture decision records (ADRs).

• Articulate technical risks, cost-capacity ratios, and strategic roadmaps clearly to audiences ranging from operations engineers to executive stakeholders.

• Internal Platform Development – In-house cloud platform management solutions development - Develop self-service platform capabilities etc.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent.

• 4+ years of total progressive industry experience in IT infrastructure and software delivery.

• 2+ years of dedicated hands-on cloud engineering, platform design, or operational experience.

• Proven track record of hands-on experience across at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). Experience in two cloud vendors would be an advantage.

Technical Competencies

• Thorough understanding or core cloud foundational services (networking/VPC peering, enterprise IAM, hybrid connectivity, compute, and container runtimes) across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a proven ability to design and manage resilient, high-performance multi-cloud platforms.

• Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Terragrunt) and modern CI/CD ecosystems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

• Strong working knowledge of configuration management and automation frameworks (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible).

• Understanding of networking, CDN caching tiers, WAF configurations (i.e. Fastly CDN, NGWAF), and hybrid cloud connectivity.

• Experience in implementing/supporting cloud security controls, encryption (at rest and in transit), key management systems, vulnerability assessments, and SIEM integrations.

• AI Governance & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with supporting governance, security controls, and resource optimization for cloud-native AI/ML services.

• Responsible AI & Compliance: Understanding of data residency, privacy frameworks, and security baselines required when deploying AI models in enterprise multi-cloud environments.

• ITSM & ITIL Frameworks: Solid working knowledge of ITIL principles, particularly concerning change enablement, incident management, problem management, and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) tracking in multi-cloud architectures.

Certifications & Soft Skills

• Cloud Certifications: Active certification from at least one major cloud provider at the minimum of Associate/Engineer level.

• Infrastructure Automation Certifications: Having HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (or higher Authoring and Operations Professional) is an added advantage.

• Service Management: Certification in ITIL v4 Foundation or above would be an added advantage.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation abilities; adept at translating complex architectural trade-offs and risks into business terms for executive leadership.

Benefits:  

• Performance-based annual bonus  

• Performance rewards and recognition  

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes  

• Entertainment allowance  

• Team engagement allowance  

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws  

• Hybrid work arrangement  

  

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Asset-intensive industry is entering an AI-enabled, data-driven, increasingly autonomous era — and nowhere is the value more concentrated than in shutdowns, turnarounds, outages, maintenance campaigns, and major capital builds, where scope, readiness, cost, and safety decide success. This role sits at the centre of that shift.

As a Principal Product Manager for Enterprise Asset Management, you'll own products that maximise asset value, reliability, and uptime while reducing risk and total cost of ownership across the full asset lifecycle — from capital build through operation, maintenance, and turnaround. You bring deep insight into project-based work — shutdowns and turnarounds (STO), campaigns of work, and major capital projects — and you champion high AI agency, treating agentic AI as a core capability, not a feature.

You'll serve asset-intensive operators across IFS's key industries- Energy, Utilities & Resources, Manufacturing, Construction & Engineering, Communication, Aerospace & Defence, and Service Industries.

Core Responsibilities

•
Strategy & Vision — Set a clear product vision and roadmap tied to measurable outcomes: asset availability, reliability, maintenance cost, and turnaround schedule and budget adherence. Build strong investment cases and drive growth across core and AI revenue streams, aligned with the Asset Lifecycle Management portfolio.

•
Customer Discovery — Lead discovery with maintenance, reliability, operations, turnaround/STO, and capital-planning leaders. Go deep on scope challenge and optimisation, readiness, resource mobilisation, scheduling, and cost/risk control. Prioritise ruthlessly on measurable value.

•
High AI Agency & Agentic Innovation — Embed agentic AI into project-based work: autonomously assembling and challenging turnaround scope, optimising campaign and outage schedules, surfacing readiness gaps, and continuously replanning as conditions change. Operate with high personal agency in your own use of AI to prototype and validate fast.

•
End-to-End Ownership — Own the lifecycle from concept to launch to scale. Remove blockers and drive to outcomes — including the hard schedule and cost deadlines that govern turnarounds and capital projects. Keep Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success aligned.

•
Commercial Impact & GTM — Define differentiation and value for asset-intensive buyers and event leaders. Support pricing, packaging, launches, and customer presentations. Own adoption as a core metric.

Qualifications
Essential

• Proven experience (6+ years) in Product Management within SaaS, platform, or enterprise software environments.
• Deep knowledge of shutdown, turnaround, major capital investment projects or similar activities in the context of EAM.
• Experienced and knowledgeable in the domain of Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance & reliability, or asset-intensive operations, with hands-on exposure to one or more of IFS's core industries (Aerospace & Defence, Energy/Utilities & Resources, Manufacturing, Construction & Engineering, Telecommunications, Service Industries).
• Demonstrated ability to define and execute product strategy, vision, and measurable outcomes.
• Hands-on experience in customer discovery, prototyping, and validating solutions.
• Proven track record of launching and scaling products from concept to adoption, delivering measurable customer value.
• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and prioritisation skills.
• Data-informed decision-making mindset, using analytics, experimentation, and evidence to guide direction.
• AI-curious.

Desirable

• Experience with developer platforms, application frameworks, data services, or AI/ML-enabled enterprise applications.
• Prior exposure to commercial responsibilities such as pricing, monetisation, or P&L ownership.
• Experience working in global, distributed organisations and partnering across geographies

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape the user experience of botim, an AI-native fintech platform serving millions of users across payments, financial services, communications, and platform capabilities.

You will design complex, high-impact fintech experiences where trust, speed, and scalability matter. Working with Product, Engineering, Data, Risk, and Growth, you will own the design of your product area end to end, and help define not just how our products look and feel, but what we build and why.

• Own product work end to end, from problem framing and concepting through launch and iteration. Stay involved through launch, not just handoff.

• Design user journeys for AI-driven fintech products including payments, wallets, onboarding, lending, and platform services.

• Turn regulatory and system complexity into intuitive workflows. Translate product strategy, user needs, data, and compliance requirements into clear flows and high-quality UI.

• 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer working on digital consumer products.

jobs.description:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Solutions Architect – AI Factory with experience in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale AI factories to join our team at NVIDIA.

In this role, you’ll connect real-world customer workloads to NVIDIA’s hardware and software ecosystem, helping developers and enterprises adopt and scale our platforms. We’re looking for someone with strong technical depth who can serve as a trusted advisor, bridge complex challenges to innovative solutions, and grow into a strategic resource for the customers and partners you support. If you’re excited about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing:

• Lead technical discovery with customer architects, engineers, and executives to understand business goals, AI/HPC workloads, performance requirements, security constraints, and deployment environments.
• Design end-to-end AI Factory solutions spanning compute, networking, storage, cluster management, workload orchestration.
• Guide customers through adoption of NVIDIA's full-stack platform.
• Run proof-of-concepts, workshops, technical enablement, demos, and architecture solution reviews, that prove technical and business value and accelerate customer adoption.
• Partner closely with sales account managers to shape technical strategy, qualify opportunities, develop solution proposals, and secure customer wins.
• Lead technical design reviews, bills of materials, deployment plans, readiness assessments, and handoffs to implementation and operations teams.
• Build and grow trusted technical relationships with engineers, architects, IT leaders, and executives at strategic customer accounts.

What we need to see:

• BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience).
• 5+ years in senior technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Systems Architect, AI/ML Platform Engineer, Technical Consultant, or similar.
• Established track record designing, deploying, or operating AI and HPC infrastructure at enterprise scale.
• Deep technical expertise in several of the following: datacenter infrastructure, distributed systems, high-performance networking, storage, cluster management, AI/HPC workload orchestration, and GPU-accelerated computing.
• Experience leading technical discovery, architecture workshops, proof-of-concepts, performance validation, and executive-level technical presentations.
• Effective collaboration across teams, combined with excellent written and verbal communication.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong experience working with enterprise customers across North Africa.
• Native or fluent in Arabic and French, plus the ability to travel across North Africa as required (20% of the working time).
• Practical background with the NVIDIA AI Factory stack.
• Experience with MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) systems used in AI Factory construction, including cooling infrastructure, power distribution, and plumbing systems.

If you're ready to take on this outstanding opportunity and help NVIDIA continue to lead the world in technology innovation, apply now!

Work with the Indemnities manager as a team in managing customer exit requests and identify possible ways of retention and apply the retention tools to minimize customer attrition and manage customer expectations and communications efficiently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform primary screening into customer's financial records from a credit and risk prospective and propose solutions while working with customers on obtaining guarantees and documents to support proposals that aim to continue the relationship.
• Prepare and submit to management proposals for cases where EOSB are received identifying possibilities in order to be able to continue with the borrowing relationship without overexposing the bank to risk.
• Proactive retention by working with Credit, Collections, Inward Remittances, Operations, Risk, branches, relationship management and other departments involved to identify the risks and potentials of a relationship in light of customer's new financial stand and attend to customer's requests.
• Assess the financial stand of the customer in light of the employment status after the final settlement from the employer is received and propose solutions and work with customers on obtaining guarantees and documents to support proposals that aim to continue the relationship.
• Carry out the operational accepts of the Indemnities department where EOSB have been received, by handling the batches received and ensuring that the alerts are put on the accounts and, when required the accounts are earmarked appropriately.
• Management of internal and external customer communications, with an overall aim to enhance customer experience and develop solid, strong and professional communication skills.
Represent the Indemnities department in meetings with all customers (internal and external) as and when required.
• Ensure all TATs of the department are met and all assigned work is completed in a timely and accurate manner.
• Follow up with other units of the bank to ensure that the process of EOSB is running smoothly to reduce any delays and avoid complaints.
• Maintain up-to-date MIS tracking all important information pertaining to every case handled, and to analyze MIS and submit weekly / monthly statistical reports that assist in KPI and learning / improvement areas.
• Ensure that all matters where a risk or breeches of the process has been identified is escalated to the management through the proper channels.
• Maintain accurate records for all transactions of the department.
• Keep up to date with information on the market offering for individual customers through research, customer declaration, information received from BIU and other sources in order to be constantly educated on what competitors are offering to various customer segments in order to be able to align our offering and solutions accordingly.
• Ensure accuracy of information shared with customer and ensure that there is no unauthorized divulging of confidential information.
• Ad-hoc duties and administrative duties towards retention.
• Adhere to the Standard Operating Procedures, Policies, Code of Conduct and Service Standards of the bank.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

• Good negotiation skills
• Good understanding of the products, policies and systems.
• Interpersonal skills to efficiency interact with customers and other business units.
• Team working skills.
• Ability to present customer's perspective and ability to perform primary initial screening into customer's financial records.
• Very good understanding of product policies, features and running campaigns.
• Knowledge in Banking Systems.
• Minimum of 2 year of experience in the same role.

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE
Identity and Access Management Manager | MAF Global Solutions | Global Solutions UAE

ROLE SUMMARY
The Identity and Access Management Manager is responsible for developing and maintaining the organization's Identity Access Management (IAM) and Privilege Access Management (PAM) strategy, roadmap, and implementation plan, aligning it with business objectives and security best practices. This includes defining the future state of identity and access management and planning for its evolution.

ROLE PROFILE

• IAM & PAM Strategy: Develop, implement, and enforce secure IAM/PAM policies, procedures, and controls aligned with least privilege and business requirements.
• Identity Lifecycle Management: Manage end-to-end user and privileged identity lifecycle, including onboarding, provisioning, access changes, certifications, and offboarding.
• Access Governance & Authentication: Implement and manage RBAC/ABAC, MFA, SSO, federation, access reviews, and strong authentication/authorization mechanisms.
• Privileged Access Management: Oversee credential vaulting and rotation, privileged session monitoring/recording, JIT access, and break-glass/emergency access procedures.
• IAM Operations & Security: Monitor IAM/PAM environments, investigate anomalies and incidents, remediate vulnerabilities, and lead identity-related incident response activities.
• Technology & Automation: Design and operate enterprise IAM/IGA/PAM solutions such as SailPoint, CyberArk, and Delinea, with automation using workflows, PowerShell, or Python.
• Compliance, Risk & Reporting: Ensure alignment with NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, GDPR, SOC 2, and audit requirements; establish KPIs, metrics, logging, and reporting.
• Leadership & Continuous Improvement: Lead IAM initiatives, vendors/MSPs, training, and stakeholder collaboration while continuously improving IAM capabilities, security, automation, and SLA performance.

REQUIREMENTS

• Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership, interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management capabilities.
• Proactive & Collaborative: Self-motivated, proactive, action-oriented, deadline-driven, and effective in collaborative team environments.
• Professional Experience: 8+ years of experience working with multiple IAM solutions in large organizations, including 5+ years of hands-on global IDAM platform management.

• Education & Certifications: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, or equivalent; preferred certifications include CIAM, CISM, CISSP, and ITIL.

JOB TITLE
Data Privacy Senior Manager | MAF Entertainment | Head Office

ROLE SUMMARY
The role of Data Privacy Senior Manager encompasses responsibility, accountability and oversight of data privacy compliance, ensuring adherence to applicable laws, internal policies and industry best practices across all of the company’s operating countries.
ROLE PROFILE

• Serve as the Data Privacy Officer and advisor on lawful, ethical data processing across all operating countries
• Implement and maintain data privacy policies, procedures, and frameworks aligned with local regulations.

• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, InfoSec, and business units to align on data protection strategies.

• Act as the main contact for regulators, managing audits and data protection inquiries.

• Relevant certifications such as CIPM or CIPP/E (preferred)
• Strong knowledge of data privacy laws and regulations across multiple jurisdictions.
• Experience with data protection tools (e.g., Securiti.AI is a plus).
• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and excellent written English.
• Self-motivated, professional, proactive, and enthusiastic with a strong work ethic.

jobs.title: UX Designer - Research-Led (IGT1)
locations: Port City, Western Province, Sri Lanka
jobs.description:
Job Description
About the role:

We're looking for a UX Designer who thrives on understanding people. You're at your best when talking to users, uncovering their needs, and translating those insights into better products. Research isn't just part of your process, it's what drives your decisions.

In this role, you'll lead the research side of our design practice, from planning studies and running usability tests to uncovering insights that directly influence our product direction. You'll also help shape how AI can enhance research by making it faster, more scalable, and more effective, while ensuring that human judgment remains at the center of every decision.

Key Responsibilities:

What you'll do

• Lead user research activities, including interviews, contextual inquiries, field studies, and usability testing (moderated and unmoderated).
• Design and execute research plans that answer real product questions, from participant recruitment and study design to scripts, tasks, and analysis.
• Turn qualitative and quantitative findings into clear insights, customer journeys, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
• Validate concepts, designs, and prototypes early and frequently, then measure success through post-release research.
• Leverage AI throughout the research process, including transcription, tagging, clustering, synthesis, interview preparation, and test design, while critically evaluating outputs and safeguarding participant privacy.
• Build and maintain a scalable research practice through templates, research repositories, standards, and shared ways of working.

The Senior Avionics Systems Engineer is responsible for defining and managing avionics system architecture, deriving and allocating system requirements across hardware, software, and control domains, and ensuring effective integration throughout the system development lifecycle. The role manages system interfaces, requirements traceability, verification and validation activities, and supports safety and certification processes in line with ARP4754A, ARP4761, DO-178C, and DO-254. Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering and certification teams, the position ensures that avionics systems are technically coherent, fully traceable, compliant, and successfully integrated at system level.

• Allocate system requirements to software, hardware, and control domains.

• Provide necessary technical inputs to software, hardware, and control teams.

• Coordinate the lifecycle activities related to writing, verifying, and validating system requirements.

• Perform system-level integration and verification activities.

• Support safety assessment activities and derived requirements management.

• Support the establishment and execution of systems engineering processes compliant with ARP4754A.

• Prepare and maintain systems engineering documentation.

• Work in coordination with software, hardware, control, test, and certification teams.

• Knowledge and experience in avionics system architecture.

• Knowledge of systems engineering design processes and related lifecycle activities.

• Knowledge and experience in ARP4754A processes.

• Experience in requirements engineering (capture, derivation, and traceability).

jobs.title: HPC System Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking a highly skilled HPC Systems Administrator to manage, optimize, and support our high-performance computing environment used for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) workloads. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of HPC operations — from infrastructure and scheduler management to user support, performance optimization, and long-term capacity planning.
The ideal candidate has strong Linux administration experience, deep knowledge of HPC schedulers, and hands-on familiarity with engineering simulation tools.

RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Infrastructure Management
• Maintain and administer compute nodes, login nodes, heterogeneous nodes, NAS storage servers, and high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand).
• Manage and maintain HPC-related databases, ensuring timely backups and audit compliance.
• Monitor hardware health including CPU temperatures, memory errors, and disk failures.
• Ensure high availability, reliability, and minimal downtime across the HPC environment.
B. Scheduler & Resource Management
• Configure and tune job schedulers (Slurm / PBS / LSF / Grid Engine).
• Implement and maintain fair-share scheduling, job priority rules, QoS limits, and preemption policies.
• Manage node reservations for large-scale CFD/FEA workloads.
• Provide best-practice recommendations for CPU/GPU architecture selection for engineering simulations.
• Prevent resource misuse, including node hogging, queue congestion, and starvation of small jobs.
C. User Access, Security & Compliance

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Internal Job Description


Embedded Software Engineer

We are looking for an Embedded Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in embedded software development, preferably within the aerospace or avionics domain. The role involves developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining safety-critical embedded software for aerospace systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for avionics, flight control, and aerospace systems. Implement and optimize real-time software ensuring minimal latency, high reliability, and deterministic performance. Collaborate with system engineers to translate control algorithms and system requirements into efficient embedded code.

• Integrate software with hardware systems and perform rigorous testing to validate functionality, performance, and compliance with safety standards. Develop software in alignment with industry standards such as DO-178C and DO-254. Optimize code for memory usage, power efficiency, and execution performance while adhering to best practices and coding standards.

• Maintain detailed documentation including design specifications, code, test plans, and results. Work cross-functionally with hardware, systems, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration. Troubleshoot and resolve defects, anomalies, and performance issues through structured debugging and analysis. Continuously stay updated with emerging technologies, tools, and industry best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (Master’s/PhD preferred).

• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in embedded software development, preferably within aerospace or safety-critical industries.

• Strong hands-on expertise in C and C++ for embedded systems. Deep understanding of microcontroller architectures such as ARM and STM32, along with low-level hardware interfacing.

Operating Environment
Ability to work effectively under pressure in fast-paced, mission-critical environments. Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to drive solutions from concept through deployment.

jobs.description:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date.

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking

- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components

- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.

- An interest in computer sciences and information technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Data Scientist

The Big Picture

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco employs over 75,000 associates, has 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide and over 14,000 IoT-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations. For fiscal year 2025 that ended June 29, 2025, the company generated sales of more than $81.4 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

The Opportunity

We are currently on the lookout for Data Scientists to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Extract, transform, and analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets using Python, SQL, and cloud-based technologies.
• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model development to address business challenges.
• Develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy machine learning models, including predictive, classification, and forecasting solutions.
• Build and maintain scalable data and machine learning pipelines for production environments.
• Develop AI-powered solutions using Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, and Agentic AI concepts.
• Monitor model performance, conduct model validation, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to ensure accuracy and reliability.
• Apply statistical analysis and experimentation techniques to identify insights and support data-driven decision-making.
• Translate analytical findings and model outputs into actionable business recommendations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Data Engineers, and other cross functional teams to deliver impactful solutions.
• Document data science methodologies, model assumptions, and technical approaches to support knowledge sharing and governance.
• Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and code quality standards.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
• Hands-on experience with data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, or similar.
• Solid understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation methodologies.
• Experience working with time-series forecasting, predictive analytics, classification models, and imbalanced datasets.
• Familiarity with data processing frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.
• Understanding of MLOps concepts, CI/CD pipelines, Git, APIs, and model deployment practices.
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Knowledge of Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and AI agents.

Benefits

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Paid birthday leave Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

• Hybrid work arrangement

jobs.summary: You will be a Prototyping Engagement Manager in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and Customer Engineering) team, based in Riyadh. You are the face of PACE for customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia — helping
jobs.description:
You will be a Prototyping Engagement Manager in the AWS PACE (Prototyping and Customer Engineering) team, based in Riyadh. You are the face of PACE for customers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia — helping enterprises turn their most ambitious ideas into working technology proofpoints on AWS.

You work at the intersection of business strategy and emerging technology. You identify the opportunities where generative AI, agentic systems, and cloud-native architectures can create the most value for a customer — then you shape, qualify, and drive those engagements from first conversation to working prototype and beyond.

You pilot a pipeline of high-value innovation opportunities, you earn the trust of C-suite and technical leaders alike, and you create the conditions for brilliant engineers to do their best work. You pair with hands-on Prototyping Architects to deliver multi-week hands-on engagements that de-risk transformation, prove out new workloads, and accelerate customers' paths to production.

You thrive in ambiguity. Your customers are navigating generational technology shifts — foundation models, autonomous agents, intelligent automation — and you help them cut through the noise, make crisp decisions, and move fast. You work backwards from customer outcomes, you insist on the highest standards in scoping and delivery, and you invent on behalf of customers who don't yet know what's possible.

This role is based in Riyadh and supports customers across KSA and the wider GCC, working alongside account teams, specialist organisations, and partners to drive workload adoption at the frontier of what AWS can do.

Key job responsibilities

You build and pilot a pipeline of innovation opportunities across KSA and the GCC — working with account teams, specialists, and partners to proactively identify where generative AI and cloud-native architecture can unlock the most value.

You qualify with rigour. You ask the hard questions early — is there a real business outcome, a committed customer, a path to production? You invest resources where they matter and disqualify where they don't.

You scope engagements that set teams up for success — working backwards from customer outcomes to define crisp, time-boxed prototypes with clear success criteria.

You drive engagements from kickoff to close — coordinating customer developers, AWS architects, and partners, mitigating risk, and ensuring every engagement closes with demonstrated value and a concrete next step.

You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders — helping executives navigate generational technology shifts and make confident investment decisions.

You scale what works — packaging repeatable motions and sharing them across the PACE community worldwide.

You represent the customer internally — feeding engagement insights back into AWS service teams and product roadmaps.

A day in the life

You start with a standup — a customer's engineering team is two weeks into a generative AI prototype and needs your help unblocking a decision. Mid-morning, you're scoping a new engagement with a Saudi enterprise exploring agentic AI. After lunch you review your pipeline, update qualifications, and plan resourcing with your Prototyping Architect. Later, you're with a customer's CTO — they've seen prototype results and want to talk path to production. You finish the day writing up a repeatable pattern you spotted, something the wider PACE team could use.

About the team

PACE (Prototyping AI and Customer Engineering) is AWS's hands-on customer innovation team. We work directly with enterprise customers to turn their boldest ideas into working technology — building prototypes that de-risk transformation and accelerate adoption.

Our model pairs Engagement Managers with Prototyping Architects: you shape the opportunity, they shape the technology, and together you deliver something real. This role sits within EMEA PACE, supporting customers across KSA and the wider GCC, backed by a worldwide community that shares patterns, tools, and lessons learned.

Basic qualifications
- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 2+ years of software development experience

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications
- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

On any given day, you'll be working directly with customers to respond to their assurance needs, helping third-party auditors understand the AWS control environment, or talking to regulators about how AWS views cloud security. Why Amazon Security

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Data Scientist

The Big Picture

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco employs over 75,000 associates, has 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide and over 14,000 IoT-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations. For fiscal year 2025 that ended June 29, 2025, the company generated sales of more than $81.4 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

The Opportunity

We are currently on the lookout for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Work on end-to-end Data Science and Machine Learning projects, from problem definition and data exploration to model development, deployment, and performance monitoring.
• Translate complex business problems into scalable analytical, machine learning, and AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
• Design and develop advanced machine learning models, including forecasting, predictive analytics, classification, recommendation systems, anomaly detection, and deep learning solutions.
• Development and deployment of Generative AI applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, Agentic AI frameworks, NLP techniques, and workflow orchestration tools.
• Own model lifecycle management, including training, deployment, monitoring, explainability, validation, governance, and performance optimization.
• Design and implement scalable cloud-based data science and AI solutions across AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent platforms.
• Perform advanced statistical analysis, experimentation, feature engineering, forecasting, and root-cause analysis to enhance model accuracy and business outcomes.
• Develop and maintain high-quality, reusable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices.
• Technical troubleshooting and resolution of complex data, model, and pipeline issues in production environments.
• Establish and promote best practices in data science, machine learning engineering, MLOps, and AI governance.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and leadership to define roadmaps and technical strategies.
• Mentor junior Data Scientists and contribute to knowledge sharing, onboarding, code reviews, and technical leadership within the team.
• Communicate technical concepts, insights, risks, assumptions, and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• 2-4 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, or related analytical disciplines.
• Advanced expertise in Python and strong proficiency in SQL. • Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Statistical Modelling, Deep Learning, Feature Engineering, and Model Evaluation techniques.
• Experience building and deploying production-scale machine learning solutions.
• Expertise in forecasting, time-series modelling, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and advanced analytics techniques.
• Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Prophet, DeepAR, or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, governance, and automation.
• Experience with workflow orchestration and data engineering tools such as Airflow, Spark, PySpark, and ETL/ELT frameworks.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including cloud-native ML and data services.
• Strong knowledge of Generative AI technologies

Benefits

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Paid birthday leave Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

• Hybrid work arrangement

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Description
We are looking for a highly motivated Finance Systems Support Analyst to join our global Finance Systems Support team.

This role is responsible for supporting and enhancing finance-related business systems, with a primary focus on IFS Cloud Finance and associated applications. The successful candidate will work closely with Finance stakeholders, IT teams, and business users to ensure systems are operating effectively, user issues are resolved promptly, and business processes continue to evolve through technology-enabled improvements.

The position offers a unique opportunity to combine finance knowledge, system expertise, problem-solving skills, and project involvement in a global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Systems Support

• Provide functional support for finance applications, including IFS Cloud Finance modules.
• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system incidents, service requests, and user queries.
• Manage support tickets in accordance with agreed service levels and priorities.
• Collaborate with technical teams and vendors to resolve complex issues.
• Monitor recurring issues and identify opportunities for permanent corrective actions.
• Ensure timely communication with stakeholders on incident progress and resolution.

Business Process & Continuous Improvement

• Partner with Finance teams to understand business requirements and challenges.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and user experience through system enhancements.
• Document business requirements and participate in solution design activities.
• Support process standardization and automation initiatives across Finance functions.
• Recommend best practices aligned with global finance processes.

System Administration & Governance

• Support maintenance of finance system configurations and master data.
• Assist with setup and administration of:

• Companies and legal entities
• General Ledger accounts and structures
• Cost centers and organizational hierarchies
• Banking configurations
• User access and security permissions
• Approval workflows and authority structures
• E-Invoicing processes and implementation.

• Ensure compliance with internal control and governance requirements.

Project & Change Delivery

• Participate in system implementations, upgrades, and enhancement projects.
• Support testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
• Assist with training, testing and post-go-live support.
• Coordinate business validation and stakeholder sign-off activities.
• Support global localization, compliance, and finance transformation initiatives.

Reporting & Data Quality

• Support finance reporting solutions and analytical tools.
• Assist users with report requirements and data investigations.
• Monitor data quality and resolve financial data discrepancies.
• Support internal and external audit requirements related to finance systems.

Training & Documentation

• Develop and maintain user guides, process documentation, and knowledge base content.
• Deliver training sessions and workshops for end users and super users.
• Promote user adoption and awareness of system capabilities.
• Contribute to self-service support resources and continuous knowledge sharing.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
• 3+ years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, or a related finance role.
• Solid understanding of General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Banking and Cash Management, including the basics - accounting principles, revenue recognition, and financial controls.
• Experience with business process analysis and requirements gathering, strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Ability to work effectively in a global and cross-functional environment.
• Experience with ERP systems (e.g., IFS applications, SAP, Oracle) is highly preferred.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Lead and manage the delivery of risk-based IT audits, and special projects, in accordance with AstraTech policies, procedures, global internal audit standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. Provide assurance and identify technology risks. Expectations will also include building effective relationships across teams within the group. Competencies will involve assessment and insights on First and Second-Line’s Risk Management over IT and Cybersecurity controls, Resilience and Business continuity controls, and Emerging Technologies that have been adopted, such as Blockchain and AI.

Pre-Audit Planning:

· Develop and oversee the execution of the annual technology audit plan, ensuring alignment with IT governance, cybersecurity, and organizational risk strategies.

· Conduct IT risk assessments to identify key areas for review and develop comprehensive audit programs tailored to technology and digital risks.

· Lead opening meetings with executive IT management to discuss audit scope, objectives, and timelines for each technology audit engagement.

· Coordinate with IT risk management, cybersecurity teams, and other risk assurance functions to ensure a cohesive approach to IT governance, risk, and compliance.

· Communicate IT audit progress, results, and insights to key stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with technology risk management objectives.

Compliance and Professional Standards:

· Coordinate with IT risk management, cybersecurity teams, and other assurance functions to ensure a cohesive approach to IT governance, risk, and compliance.

jobs.title: Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Overview

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

The Enterprise Architect (Cloud, Infrastructure & Healthcare Platforms) is responsible for defining and governing the target architecture across cloud, infrastructure, networking, security, identity, workplace technologies, AI platforms, and healthcare systems. The role ensures technology decisions support patient safety, operational resilience, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and digital transformation while providing architectural leadership from strategy through implementation and operations.

Responsibilities

• Develop and govern enterprise architecture strategies, standards, roadmaps, and reference architectures across Azure, infrastructure, networking, security, identity, workplace, and healthcare platforms.
• Design and oversee hybrid cloud and on-premises environments, including Azure landing zones, data centres, disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and operational resilience.
• Establish architecture standards for Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Intune, cybersecurity, Zero Trust, and secure access management.
• Provide architecture direction for healthcare systems and integrations, including EMR/EHR, HIS, PACS, RIS, LIS, and clinical applications.
• Lead architecture governance, design reviews, technology evaluations, vendor assessments, RFPs, and investment planning.
• Define AI platform strategy, AI governance, Azure AI services, GPU infrastructure, MLOps/LLMOps, security controls, and responsible AI adoption.
• Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, privacy requirements, ADHICS, ISO 27001, NIST, and cybersecurity frameworks.
• Mentor architects and senior engineers while communicating architectural decisions, risks, costs, and recommendations to business and technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 12+ years of infrastructure, cloud, network, or cybersecurity experience, including at least 5 years in enterprise or solution architecture leadership.

jobs.title: Software Architect (Payments)
jobs.description:
Software Architect (Payments)

Location: Abu Dhabi

ABOUT US

A leading UAE-based consumer technology company, building the digital infrastructure of everyday life with a focus on AI-powered fintech, communication, and digital services.

Guided by our philosophy, the Blueprint of Simplicity, we design technology around real human behavior, connecting people, enabling financial access, and making everyday experiences effortless.

Our flagship platform, botim, is the region’s most trusted fintech communication platform, combining secure VoIP with action-based AI and everyday money tools. Through botim money, we provide financial services that serve both individuals and SMEs, making payments, transfers, and credit simpler and more accessible. Today, the platform serves 150M+ users worldwide.

Our lending finance engine, Quantix, powers fast, regulated credit across the ecosystem, including innovative products such as CashNow for instant access.

From calls to credit, from daily services to big ambitions, we are rethinking how the region stays connected and financially included.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are at a critical juncture — building and scaling next-generation payment systems across merchant acquiring and core payment processing, powering real-time transaction flows at production scale. This is a high-impact, cross-platform role where you will own backend architecture, make authoritative technical decisions across multiple squads, and directly shape the technical direction of our payments platform.

You will serve as the technical architectural bridge between the Chief Architect and engineering execution — translating product intent into scalable, production-ready payment systems, guiding a pod of engineers through what good looks like, and setting the standard that every squad builds to. You will be the person teams come to when a decision needs to be made, a trade-off needs to be owned, or a design needs to be challenged. You know the payment ecosystem inside out — from how a transaction moves across card schemes, through switching layers, into clearing and settlement, to how regulatory and compliance constraints shape every design decision. Our platform is built on a Java microservices stack operating at the intersection of real-time transaction processing, card scheme integration, and regulated financial infrastructure — and this role sits at the centre of all of it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Platform Architecture & Ownership

Architect and evolve systems spanning Merchant Management, POS, and eCommerce acceptance. You own the platform architecture across acquiring and adjacent payment services — not scoped to a single squad or vertical. Design for high throughput, low latency, and production-first reliability across auth, clearing, settlement, and reconciliation flows.

Technical Direction Across Squads

You will own Technical architectural direction and design decisions across multiple engineering squads simultaneously. You are the person who holds the full-system technical view when individual squads optimise locally. Lead and mentor a pod of engineers — owning design quality and delivery accountability.

Product & Business Alignment

Work directly with Product Owners to translate product intent and regulatory requirements into technically sound, scalable, and auditable system designs. You bridge the gap between what is being asked and what should be built — and you communicate that clearly in both directions.

Protocol, Integration & Hands-on Engineering

Define the integration architecture across card schemes, payment processor, and internal switching layers — setting the technical standards for payment integration including ISO 8583 message design, inter-service communication patterns using Dubbo or a comparable RPC framework, and how the acquiring service mesh connects and fails safely. Stay hands-on — contribute to critical Java microservice components, lead code and architecture reviews, and resolve complex production issues. At this level, you code because it makes your architecture better, not because no one else can.

API & Event-Driven Architecture

Design REST/JSON APIs with strong emphasis on idempotency, fault tolerance, and exactly-once semantics. Drive event-driven flows using RabbitMQ for transaction lifecycle events, downstream processing, and asynchronous workflows. Design Redis-backed patterns for distributed caching, idempotency key management, rate limiting, and real-time state. Design systems that are operable and diagnosable — not just functional.

AI-Augmented Engineering

We use Claude Code as our default AI coding assistant and expect this role to use it generously — for architecture reviews, code and test generation, runbook creation, log triage, and elimination of manual engineering toil. Automate aggressively: If a task is repetitive, it is a candidate for AI automation and you will lead it for the team.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

— 12 to 15 years of backend or platform engineering experience — with a material portion spent building, owning, and operating production card payment systems at a licensed Fintech, payment processor, acquirer, or financial institution. Experience must span architecture, delivery, and production ownership — not advisory proximity to payments.

— Expert-level Java and Spring Boot proficiency — microservices design, Application framework, transactional integrity, service decomposition, and production API development. You are expected to review code and jump to write one where required, not just approve designs. Testing literacy is assumed; the bar here is designing systems that are testable by default.

— Deep, production-proven command of ISO 8583 and payment messaging — Deep knowledge of full transaction lifecycle — authorisation, clearing and settlement — with enough protocol fluency to make authoritative architecture decisions on message design, switching topology, and host connectivity. Prior experience with jPOS or an equivalent switching framework is expected; what matters at this level is the judgment to define how these systems connect, fail, and recover at acquiring scale — not just operate them. Ability to reason clearly about synchronous vs. asynchronous processing trade-offs in high-volume acquiring environments.

— Demonstrated experience integrating with payment gateways and processors — REST and ISO-based integration, hosted payment pages, tokenisation, EMV 3DS 2.x authentication, and back-office reconciliation. Prior work with MPGS, Cybersource or leading gateway integration is a strong asset — particularly where you owned the integration and drove implementation.

— Experience working with RabbitMQ or Kafka message broker — designing reliable transactional event flows, exchange/queue topology, dead-letter queue strategies, and message acknowledgement patterns in a high-volume payment environment.

— Worked with Dubbo or a comparable RPC framework (gRPC) for synchronous inter-service communication — with the judgment to decide when RPC is the right pattern over async messaging, and how to design for failure isolation across service boundaries.

— Architect Leader — leads a pod of engineers by example, setting the standard through what you produce: solution design documents, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and integration specifications the team learns from. Equally comfortable running a design review with engineers and presenting architecture trade-offs to Product, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders.

CORE TECHNOLOGY STACK

Required: Java / Spring Boot · ISO 8583 · jPOS · MPGS / Cybersource / Payment gateway · RabbitMQ / Kafka · Redis · gRPC Framework · REST APIs · Microservices · GitLab / GitHub · MySQL / MongoDB / Elastic Search

Strong Asset: Azure / AWS · 3DS (EMV 3DS 2.x) · EMV · Tokenisation · Visa / Mastercard Scheme Integration · CI/CD · TOGAF

JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Technical Operations Engineer – Data Platforms

About Sysco LABS:

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

The Opportunity:

We are currently on the lookout for a Senior Technical Operations (Senior Data Operations Engineer) Engineer to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Maintain the health, availability, reliability, and performance of enterprise data platforms, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure through proactive monitoring and operational support.
• Implement and enhance observability through monitoring, alerting, and logging to proactively detect, troubleshoot, and minimize data pipeline failures and service disruptions.
• Provide Level 2 production support for complex incidents, leading technical investigations, validating data integrity, restoring services, and meeting established SLA commitments.
• Lead technical incident resolution and follow established ITSM processes for incident, service request, problem, change, and knowledge management.
• Drive problem management by performing root cause analysis, identifying recurring issues, and implementing corrective and preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents.
• Support and coordinate production changes in accordance with established ITSM change management processes, including impact assessment, approvals, implementation, validation, and post-change verification.
• Develop and enhance automation using Python and Shell scripting, and optimize AWS and GCP environments to improve reliability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.
• Create and improve SOPs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks to strengthen knowledge management and standardize operational practices.
• Drive continual service improvement by identifying operational gaps, automation opportunities, and improvements to service reliability and efficiency.
• Collaborate with SREs, Data Engineers, and cross-functional teams to resolve complex issues, improve platform resilience, and mentor junior engineers.
• Participate in a 24x7 support rotation roster to ensure the continuous availability of business-critical data platforms and services.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering or an equivalent qualification.
• 3+ years of experience in Data Platform Operations, Production Support, Platform Operations, or a similar role supporting enterprise data platforms.
• Proven experience providing Level 2 production support, incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, data validation, and service restoration within established SLA commitments.
• Practical experience applying ITIL principles and ITSM practices across incident, service request, problem, change, and knowledge management processes.
• Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Shell scripting, with hands-on experience supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, Apache Airflow/Cloud Composer workflows, and Apache Kafka-based streaming platforms.
• Experience working with cloud-native data platforms and services on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, Glue, Redshift, Athena, EMR, DynamoDB) and Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Datastream).
• Hands-on experience implementing observability and monitoring solutions using Datadog or similar platforms.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to lead technical investigations and troubleshoot complex production environments.
